technologies.desc: By harnessing the entropic nature of the Null Void, this beam can actually destroy energy.
technologies.name: Null Void Beam

technologies.desc: The progress we make calls for a new, nimbler form of administration that may aid rather than hinder us in our pursuits.
technologies.name: Adaptive Bureaucracy

technologies.desc: Organics often fight using illogical and unpredictable tactics that can be difficult to effectively counter. Adaptive tactics and new, more maneuverable warforms should provide a decisive advantage.
technologies.name: Adaptive Combat Algorithms

technologies.desc: Organizational circuitry rerouting academic fervor.
technologies.name: Administrative AI

technologies.desc: By consolidating local weather control systems, planetary weather patterns can be manipulated to significantly reduce most of the cosmic storms' harmful effects on production.
technologies.name: Planetary Storm Nullification

technologies.desc: The widespread use of advanced ceramics in industry can improve metallurgical yields.
technologies.name: Ceramo-Metal Alloys

technologies.desc: By replacing antiquated ceramo-metal equipment with cutting edge technology, we can run our forges hotter and longer, increasing production.
technologies.name: Durasteel-Laced Alloys

technologies.desc: Continued study into astrometeorology grants us the power to more precisely bend and manipulate Cosmic Storms to our own needs.
technologies.name: Advanced Storm Manipulation

technologies.desc: These powerful thrusters provide additional combat speed but consume a great deal of power.
technologies.name: Afterburners

technologies.desc: This improved version of the standard afterburners provide an even greater boost to a ship's combat speed.
technologies.name: Advanced Afterburners

technologies.desc: The universe tends irresistibly onwards and downwards. That tendency cannot be reversed... but it can be subverted, for a price.
technologies.name: Entropic Recursion

technologies.desc: A set of social protocols based on paradoxical intuition, and on love. When we know the System of the Loop, we learn that we can influence by receiving instructions, as well as giving them.
technologies.name: Doctrine: Strange Loop

technologies.desc: When a temporal paradox becomes tangled, a kind of consciousness arises, with its own needs, its own desires. This is what has occurred with the consciousness that some call the Worm-in-Waiting. If we can align ourselves with that consciousness, we might just achieve a kind of immortality.
technologies.name: Omega Theory

technologies.desc: In a carefully controlled environment, we can incubate the Genetic Material collected from culled Space Fauna and produce new members of each species under our command.
technologies.name: Artificial Breeding

technologies.desc: Studying the fauna of other worlds gives insight into alien behaviors, allowing us to identify and domesticate docile entities.
technologies.name: Xenology

technologies.desc: Civilizations flourish in locations that promotes growth, and by analyzing where the majority of pre-FTL settlements thrive we can gain more out of our colonies.
technologies.name: Alien Topography

technologies.desc: By exposing biological material to simulated chthonian-level radiation, we can fossilize cellular structures into usable metallic alloys.
technologies.name: Alloy Fossilization

technologies.desc: Solid holographic casts can alter their shapes at a moment's notice, speeding up alloy production.
technologies.name: Holographic Casts

technologies.desc: Nano-separators are a revolutionary new step in the creation of alloys, simplifying the casting process while improving overall production quality.
technologies.name: Nano-Separators

technologies.desc: By altering the breeding process of Space Amoebas, we can program their symbiotic flagella to act as organic strike craft for our navy.
technologies.name: Flagella Weaponization

technologies.desc: By harnessing the energy produced by matter/antimatter annihilations, our efficiency at generating ship power will be orders of magnitude better than fusion.
technologies.name: Antimatter Power

technologies.desc: Powerful weapons that launch a lightning arc of chaotic energy at targets, which in part can ignore armor and shields.
technologies.name: Arc Emitters

technologies.desc: These upgraded emitters are equipped with better focusing lenses, resulting in a more powerful energy discharge.
technologies.name: Focused Arc Emitters

technologies.desc: Various artifacts and technologies functioning by arcane means that cannot be understood or replicated... at least not by conventional science as it is known to us.
technologies.name: Arcane Deciphering

technologies.desc: Ping repeaters and optic diffusers with the right wavelengths can produce destructive interference and effectively scramble hostile targeting systems.
technologies.name: Ancient Target Scrambler

technologies.desc: This high energy weapon causes brutal micro collapsing events on impact, generating tremendous heat and force inside its targets armor.
technologies.name: Ancient Cavitation Collapser

technologies.desc: This cannon fires a barrage of ancient miniscule ionized spheres that charge upon contact with most force fields, giving them high levels of shield penetration. Any theory that these spheres could have been used for jewelry purposes were dismissed when a critical incident melted an entire laboratory.
technologies.name: Ancient Saturator Artillery

technologies.desc: These cannons of gargantuan size deliver relatively slow but devastating projectiles, and can fire pretty much anything, from scrap metal, to asteroid chunks.
technologies.name: Ancient Macro Batteries

technologies.desc: Particle charges, once stabilized thanks to ancient technology, allow us to create swarms of tiny missiles that still carry a respectable payload, and should be able to overwhelm most point-defense systems.
technologies.name: Ancient Nano-Missile Cloud Launcher

technologies.desc: Supercharging shields can be done safely thanks to ancient stabilizer coils and dampeners. In addition to the production of a stronger force field, this also has the added benefit of outright vaporizing certain incoming projectiles.
technologies.name: Ancient Shield Overcharger

technologies.desc: A colossal mind-wiping cannon which unleashes a planet-wide wave of energy, returning most sentient life to a pre-sapient state. We estimate that with additional tuning, it might also be used to wipe clean memory banks and disable robotic units.
technologies.name: Devolving Beam

technologies.desc: When it comes to tracking and shooting down missiles, these antique batteries are the best of the best, making use of a predictive algorithm written in long forgotten code to weave a fiery defensive web.
technologies.name: Ancient Defensive Web Slinger

technologies.desc: Defense platforms are a cost effective way to ensure our safety, but they need to be monitored from an operation center. Fortifying our Starbase to ensure its survivability in the event of an attack, and maximizing our capacity to network independent orbital defenses would give us more time to dispatch reinforcements.
technologies.name: Ancient Rampart

technologies.desc: This millennia-old processing equipment has an efficiency rate above 100%. Its functioning remains alien, but its production gains are substantial.
technologies.name: Ancient Refinery

technologies.desc: These high velocity drones have been equipped with antique mining lasers that virtually ignore any plating protecting their target. A tech too good to be wasted on astro mining.
technologies.name: Ancient Driller Drones

technologies.desc: Tremendous medium range firepower will enable our titans to break through enemy lines. These ancient cannons were once the foundation upon which a galactic empire was built.
technologies.name: Ancient Ruination Glare

technologies.desc: Ionized plates of armor can carry a reactive charge to alleviate the energy of impacts, using magnetic repulsion and field projection principles.
technologies.name: Ancient Pulse Armor

technologies.desc: Projected farther than regular shields, the suspension field technology uses ancient artifacts to slow time at the point of impact to afford the shields a longer opportunity to dispel the incoming attack's energy.
technologies.name: Ancient Suspension Field

technologies.desc: This new field of studies focuses on the practical applications of ancient artifacts. We are far from being the first galactic civilization to tread these stars. With a bit of work, their legacies could secure our future.
technologies.name: Archaeostudies

technologies.desc: A shipboard lab with advanced archaeological equipment, including a vast database supplied by the Curator Order where new discoveries can easily be cross-referenced.
technologies.name: Curator Archaeology Lab

technologies.desc: A shipboard lab with advanced archaeological equipment, including a vast database supplied by the Curator Order where new discoveries can easily be cross-referenced.
technologies.name: Curator Archaeology Lab

technologies.desc: Our society need not be limited to one home. With the ability to construct additional Arkships, every direction becomes a path, and every path becomes ours.
technologies.name: Arkship Construction

technologies.desc: The Exodus Coordinator is still largely a prototype that will one day enable us to cross to different galaxies in the blink of an eye.
technologies.name: Exodus Jump Coordinator

technologies.desc: Smaller celestial bodies can be crushed and processed in these enormous gears, providing us with a bounty of materials.
technologies.name: Planetary Reprocessor

technologies.desc: A dark matter injection system capable of triggering stellar-scale fusion events. It has no safe setting.
technologies.name: Stellar Engine

technologies.desc: The void speaks, and for those who know to listen, it whispers the secrets of the countless worlds in its embrace.
technologies.name: Subspace Imaging Array

technologies.desc: Refined structural design and improved drive systems allow for a new generation of Arkships: carrying more of who we are, further than we have ever gone.
technologies.name: Arkship Engineering

technologies.desc: The pinnacle of mobile megastructure engineering. These Arkships represent the full extent of what a traveling civilization can achieve.
technologies.name: Arkship Mastery

technologies.desc: Incorporating a crystal lattice in our ship's defenses provides some resistance to weapons that normally cut through armor.
technologies.name: Armor Hardening

technologies.desc: Threads of living metal react to incoming fire, rearranging itself to better resist penetrating weapons fire.
technologies.name: Adaptive Armor Hardening

technologies.desc: It is circumstance that dictates what is moral. Define the circumstances, and ethics is like clay in your hands.
technologies.name: Artificial Moral Codes

technologies.desc: Our history is a repeating cycle of dramatic technological, political, and cultural leaps; these leaps are often preceded by periods of upheaval and followed by times of relative stability. By identifying the core, recurring premises of these leaps, we may be able to effectively short-circuit the cycle for our own benefit.
technologies.name: Ascension Theory

technologies.desc: The invasion of another world is a staggering enterprise. There are immense logistical challenges that must be overcome before we can muster our first interplanetary armies.
technologies.name: Interplanetary Expeditionary Forces

technologies.desc: Rapid iteration in construction simulations determines the optimal component assembly patterns for each building project ahead of time.
technologies.name: Assembly Patterns

technologies.desc: Coupling detection arrays with the computers onboard our science vessels can vastly increase their scanning resolution.
technologies.name: Advanced Detection Algorithms

technologies.desc: The shell of a Cutholoid is not mineral alone, but reinforced with strong biological fibers. We can synthesize this process using advanced metallurgic techniques.
technologies.name: Asteroidal Carapace

technologies.desc: The harvesting of torn astral fabric along the scars of rifts in space and time is made possible with delicate modifications to our research stations.
technologies.name: Astral Harvesting

technologies.desc: Due to our vast experience operating observation stations in orbit of pre-FTL worlds, we have discovered slight optimizations. By implementing them empire-wide, we can drastically reduce the maintenance our stations require.
technologies.name: Atmospheric Orbital Mechanics

technologies.desc: Psionic emanations from the Shroud long to expand. With this new understanding, an empire's Psionic Auras can increase in intensity and spread throughout star systems, bringing benefits to allies and disadvantages to foes.
technologies.name: Psionic Aura Intensification

technologies.desc: There is a way to project Psionic Auras beyond populated worlds. With the addition of an Psionic Projector, even a starbase can become a conduit for psionic emanations from the Shroud.
technologies.name: Aura Resonation

technologies.desc: Large-caliber ballistic weapons that fire cased explosive shells. The main advantage of these cannons is their high rate of fire.
technologies.name: Autocannons

technologies.desc: These upgraded rotary autocannons feature improved tracking and fire control systems. This allows them to maintain an even higher rate of fire.
technologies.name: Ripper Cannons

technologies.desc: Advanced rotary autocannons capable of spewing a cloud of high-explosive shells at a target.
technologies.name: Stormfire Cannons

technologies.desc: Continuous, asynchronous analysis of disparate data sets allows for the accurate modeling of hitherto-unpredictable fluctuations in social currents.
technologies.name: Automated Curation Algorithms

technologies.desc: An advanced AI will aid science officers in their task to explore strange new worlds, to seek out new life and new civilizations, to boldly go where no Blorg has gone before. The Science Ship will be able to explore the galaxy with help from an AI.
technologies.name: Automated Exploration Protocols

technologies.desc: Semi-independent units have proved critical to the success of the greater whole.
technologies.name: Autonomous Agents

technologies.desc: By installing an auxiliary fire-control system our ships can afford to make more advanced calculations, increasing accuracy.
technologies.name: Auxiliary Fire-control

technologies.desc: A micro-unit of prevention is worth a macro-unit of cure. Sometimes, however, both are needed.
technologies.name: Medical Care

technologies.desc: The basic industrial infrastructure that is required to become a spacefaring civilization.
technologies.name: Industrial Base

technologies.desc: Testable predictions of observable phenomena.
technologies.name: Scientific Method

technologies.desc: As we explore the galaxy, we continually encounter new materials and substances that are unfamiliar to us. Cataloging and analyzing these discoveries will require new facilities.
technologies.name: Exotic Materials Labs

technologies.desc: To expand our knowledge base, we must consider all levels of existence. A new realm of science awaits us!
technologies.name: Multi-Dimensional Studies

technologies.desc: Establishing new standards for how we design and construct massive battleships greatly improves the speed at which they can be assembled.
technologies.name: Standardized Battleship Patterns

technologies.desc: Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable battleships.
technologies.name: Improved Battleship Hulls

technologies.desc: The latest generation of battleship hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.
technologies.name: Advanced Battleship Hulls

technologies.desc: The largest of the standard military vessels, Battleships are traditionally heavily armored and sport several gun batteries.
technologies.name: Battleships

technologies.desc: These advanced motivators are both smaller and lighter than previous versions, allowing robotic units to allocate additional space for subsystems.
technologies.name: Binary Motivators

technologies.desc: A facility where organic matter is converted into energy at a highly efficient rate.
technologies.name: Bio-Reactor

technologies.desc: A facility where organic matter is converted into energy at a highly efficient rate, improvements in waste collection allows harvesting of useful gaseous by-products.
technologies.name: Advanced Bio-Reactor

technologies.desc: Millions of years of organic evolution will sometimes, through sheer persistence, produce elegant solutions that can also be applied to machine designs.
technologies.name: Biomechanics

technologies.desc: Repurposed small-caliber artillery that fire piercing hooks attached to resilient carbon fiber cables, perfect for immobilizing and boarding enemy ships.
technologies.name: Boarding Cables

technologies.desc: A beam of directed tachyon energy is fired into the star, triggering a supernova. The incredible energy released by this event is then used to generate vast quantities of dark matter. When the star detonates, ALL colonies, megastructures, and stations in the system are destroyed - including our own. All fleets in the system will go MIA. The Star-Eater itself is the only exception.
technologies.name: Star Cracker

technologies.desc: We leave nothing to chance, no matter the cost. Through exacting curation of DNA banks do we build the leaders of tomorrow.
technologies.name: Capacity Boosters

technologies.desc: As our colonies become more developed, we can gain significant improvements to our throughput.
technologies.name: Improved Production

technologies.desc: Increased population density gives us an opportunity to further increase productivity.
technologies.name: Efficiencies of Scale

technologies.desc: Continued advancements in technology allow our most developed planets to reach productivity levels unheard of in earlier times.
technologies.name: Maximized Productivity

technologies.desc: Creating dedicated headquarters for all levels of military operations shapes an efficient fleet, and lays a better foundation for future military training.
technologies.name: Centralized Command

technologies.desc: More than a vessel, the Civilian Arkship is a world unto itself. Its infrastructure supports a complete society in motion, carrying with it everything needed to thrive across the stars.
technologies.name: Civilian Arkships

technologies.desc: By advancing our understanding of atmospheric transformation, we will be able to terraform even the most ecologically devastated worlds.
technologies.name: Climate Restoration

technologies.desc: A modified particle field allows our vessels to effectively 'hide' in open space. However, this comes at the cost of destabilizing other forms of energy shielding which would otherwise protect the ship.
technologies.name: Basic Cloaking Fields

technologies.desc: Advancements in rare crystal lensing technology have greatly improved cloaking efficiency.
technologies.name: Advanced Cloaking Fields

technologies.desc: Typical cloaking technology can play havoc with a ship's more delicate instruments. However, these elite fields render such concerns obsolete.
technologies.name: Elite Cloaking Fields

technologies.desc: This device uses dark matter to warp space-time around the vessel, making it incredibly difficult to detect.
technologies.name: Dark Matter Cloaking Fields

technologies.desc: Psi-Phase Field Generators focus the psionic potential of the ship's crew to partially phase the vessel into the Shroud. This allows the ship to remain undetected by all but the best sensor arrays, though what the crew may be forced to witness is better left unsaid.
technologies.name: Psi-Phase Field Generator

technologies.desc: Breakthroughs in enucleation and artificial womb technology allows for the mass-production of individuals based on a common genetic template.
technologies.name: Cloning

technologies.desc: The ability to sustain a fusion reaction at relatively low temperatures will result in a new generation of fusion reactors for our ships.
technologies.name: Cold Fusion Power

technologies.desc: Together, we build the future.
technologies.name: Collective Production Methods

technologies.desc: Finding aspects of the self within the group is natural and inevitable; eventually those shared aspects must be valued higher than individual identities.
technologies.name: The Collective Self

technologies.desc: Local administrative developments allow for closer supervision of colonial affairs without excessively burdening central decision-making.
technologies.name: Colonial Bureaucracy

technologies.desc: Robust frameworks for local governance created on a per-case basis, to meet each colony's needs.
technologies.name: Colonial Centralization

technologies.desc: Calculating required resources and gear required to establish a planetary colony allows us to herd brave pioneers into grand colony ships, confident that they will survive the long voyage across the stars to a new home.
technologies.name: New Worlds Protocol

technologies.desc: By adjusting atmospheric filtering on a per-site basis to better filter out undesirable elements, colonial living conditions may be improved.
technologies.name: Atmospheric Filtering

technologies.desc: Further study into the hazardous environments found on other planets help alleviate the difficulties that colonizers encounter in their day-to-day lives on foreign worlds.
technologies.name: Hostile Environment Adaptation

technologies.desc: Extensive study into different soil types and their ability to support crops will help improve the living conditions of our settlers on foreign worlds.
technologies.name: Foreign Soil Enrichment

technologies.desc: Additional study into different planetary climates will allow us to settle our population on worlds previously thought too hostile to support them.
technologies.name: Eco-Integration Studies

technologies.desc: Advances in mega-engineering blur the lines between reality and fantasy in the form of Colossus-type military vessels. These immense, single-weapon platforms are capable of radically altering or obliterating entire worlds at the push of a button.
technologies.name: Colossi

technologies.desc: Active matrices tuned for specific combat-centric tasks greatly improve engagement efficiency.
technologies.name: Specialized Combat Computers

technologies.desc: Further advances in predictive algorithms allow for augmented tactical decision-making in the field.
technologies.name: Extended Combat Algorithms

technologies.desc: Running sapient AIs through high-intensity combat simulations yields valuable insight into potential optimizations for risk-evaluation techniques.
technologies.name: Sapient Combat Simulations

technologies.desc: Granting our ships their own semi-autonomous intellect will greatly enhance their responsiveness in combat.
technologies.name: Autonomous Ship Intellects

technologies.desc: We can develop specialized neurochips to influence the behavior of space fauna involved in wide scale fleet combat.
technologies.name: Combat Computer Bio-integration

technologies.desc: A more extensive training program for new recruits, including realistic combat scenarios, prepare them for the field.
technologies.name: Combat Training

technologies.desc: Restructuring the chain of command and deciding what interdependencies are set between officers, make fleets more responsive and effective.
technologies.name: Command Matrix

technologies.desc: While no one civilization has the perfect solution to the ever-expanding challenge of governing a growing nation, we have found a partial solution. After studying a multitude of species and governments, we have discovered an outstanding balance of flexibility and function.
technologies.name: Compact Living

technologies.desc: Through our understanding of physics and field manipulation, our holy places shall we seen and felt by all.
technologies.name: Consecration Fields

technologies.desc: Standardized pre-fab templates massively reduce on-site facility construction times.
technologies.name: Construction Templates

technologies.desc: Basic administrative AIs can be used to streamline supply and demand lines, reducing waste.
technologies.name: Market Analysis Algorithms

technologies.desc: Using advanced AIs, we can reliably predict consumer demand before it exists.
technologies.name: Predictive Consumerism

technologies.desc: Gravity Snares capture double the amount of Space Fauna.
technologies.name: Curator Containment Protocols

technologies.desc: We can increase the effectiveness of our Space Fauna Ships by modifying their genomes, allowing us to integrate artificial technology into their biomass.
technologies.name: Controlled Mutations

technologies.desc: We can go further. Advanced manipulation of Space Fauna genetics allows for integrating a wider variety of specialized components.
technologies.name: Advanced Controlled Mutations

technologies.desc: Establishing new standards for the modeling and construction of corvettes greatly improves the efficiency of the production pipeline.
technologies.name: Standardized Corvette Patterns

technologies.desc: Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable corvettes.
technologies.name: Improved Corvette Hulls

technologies.desc: The latest generation of corvette hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.
technologies.name: Advanced Corvette Hulls

technologies.desc: The FTL breakthrough allowed early attempts to adapt traditional surface-to-space shuttle frames to military applications to finally create relatively small, fast, and maneuverable vessels with limited firepower.
technologies.name: Corvettes

technologies.desc: These formidable ships are closer to mobile fortresses than anything else, and only the most brutal assaults have a chance to damage them.
technologies.name: Paradox Titan

technologies.desc: Another optimized spacecraft, this time of larger dimensions, will make current Battleships look like toys.
technologies.name: Enigma Battlecruiser

technologies.desc: The radical shift in perspective required to comprehend the infinite layers of reality challenges even our most brilliant minds.
technologies.name: Exponential Learning Theory

technologies.desc: Gravity and spacetime shape the universe. Starting with gravity, we will master tools to power our ascension.
technologies.name: Gravitic Brush

technologies.desc: Precise and incredibly minute alterations in gravity allow us to inject commands into the code of reality. Extreme caution is imperative as we learn the applications of this new and incredible tool.
technologies.name: Theoretical Infinity Thesis

technologies.desc: Recent experiments confirm that our edits to reality are only temporary. More significant alterations will be necessary to anchor these changes.
technologies.name: The Rules of Reality

technologies.desc: Large-scale travel to different universes is a daunting task. We must engineer a spacecraft that can not only pierce the fabric of spacetime but also survive the journey. Fallen Empires will try to stop us!
technologies.name: Nascent Universes

technologies.desc: A starship of modest size that optimizes our knowledge of spacetime to enact dimensional transcendentalism, making the inside bigger than its outward shape suggests. Advanced firepower capabilities come at a reduced logistical cost compared to traditional ship designs.
technologies.name: Riddle Escort

technologies.desc: These Harbingers nest their strike craft in interwoven pocket dimensions, each ship a labyrinth of impossible hangars, capable of deploying a fleet's worth of firepower.
technologies.name: Maze Harbinger

technologies.desc: Through organic spacetime-dimensional transcendentalism, this Mauler is larger on the inside its compact frame concealing a dense tangle of musculature. Capable of a bite deadlier than physics should allow.
technologies.name: Cipher Mauler

technologies.desc: Brimming with more weapon systems than its power source should sustain, this Stinger shouldn't function, and yet, it fires. Continuously.
technologies.name: Cryptic Stinger

technologies.desc: By making further alterations to reality's rules, we can better monitor its reactions. At this scale, the effects are still difficult to predict, and could affect the entire galaxy.
technologies.name: Applied Infinity Thesis

technologies.desc: Equipped with support weapon arrays that outstrip its visible anatomy, the Quandary Weaver rewrites spatial norms. Alone, it can shift the momentum of entire battles.
technologies.name: Quandary Weaver

technologies.desc: Colossal in scale, the Synaptic Lathe is a reservoir computer. The processing power of our population's networked minds is used to compute and store data. The benefits are obvious, but some misguided species may view the transmutation of individuals into computing chips as morally questionable.
technologies.name: Scalable Reservoir Computing

technologies.desc: We have discovered how to let psionic energy flow through our ships. Armed with this knowledge, we can now imbue our vessels with the powers of our patron.
technologies.name: Mark of the Composer

technologies.desc: We have discovered how to let psionic energy flow through our ships. Armed with this knowledge, we can now imbue our vessels with the powers of our patron.
technologies.name: Mark of the Cradle

technologies.desc: We have discovered how to let psionic energy flow through our ships. Armed with this knowledge, we can now imbue our vessels with the powers of our patron.
technologies.name: Mark of the Eater

technologies.desc: We have discovered how to let psionic energy flow through our ships. Armed with this knowledge, we can now imbue our vessels with the powers of our patron.
technologies.name: Mark of the Instrument

technologies.desc: We have discovered how to let psionic energy flow through our ships. Armed with this knowledge, we can now imbue our vessels with the powers of our patron.
technologies.name: Mark of the Whisperers

technologies.desc: Vacuum gardens full of bio-engineered fruits, genetically enhanced to attract spaceborne fauna.
technologies.name: Fruit Gardens

technologies.desc: Establishing new standards for the modeling and construction of cruisers greatly improves the efficiency of the production pipeline.
technologies.name: Standardized Cruiser Patterns

technologies.desc: Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable cruisers.
technologies.name: Improved Cruiser Hulls

technologies.desc: The latest generation of cruiser hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.
technologies.name: Advanced Cruiser Hulls

technologies.desc: Originally devised as an experimental next-generation colony ship hull configuration, the design's ample hardpoints made it ideal for carrying heavy weapons ordnance.
technologies.name: Cruisers

technologies.desc: By giving control of the colony ship to the on-board computer, the crew and colonists can be placed in suspended animation.
technologies.name: Automated Colony Ships

technologies.desc: Sufficiently advanced systems are capable of optimizing themselves if they are made acutely aware of the purpose for which they were made.
technologies.name: Self-Aware Colony Ships

technologies.desc: By harnessing the subthermal dynamics found in the environments of frozen worlds, we can create more hospitable living conditions in colder climates.
technologies.name: Frozen World Habitats

technologies.desc: By infusing armor plating with Crystalline matter we are able to further increase the durability of our ships' protective hulls.
technologies.name: Crystal-Infused Plating

technologies.desc: Introducing Crystalline matter into the forging process further improves the ultra-hard qualities of crystal-infused metals.
technologies.name: Crystal-Forged Plating

technologies.desc: An understanding of a shared past is necessary in order to make any significant strides into the future.
technologies.name: Sociocultural History

technologies.desc: These shipboard lab facilities incorporate advanced technologies from the ancient Curator Order to further increase survey speeds.
technologies.name: Curator Exploration Lab

technologies.desc: Tactical disruption of natural habitats combined with converging search-and-destroy patterns can effectively eliminate hostile wildlife in a very short span of time.
technologies.name: Dangerous Wildlife Removal

technologies.desc: These deflectors utilize dark matter to deflect incoming projectiles in a way that seems to utterly defy the laws of nature.
technologies.name: Dark Matter Deflectors

technologies.desc: Dark matter resonance chambers will significantly improve the performance of our detection arrays.
technologies.name: Dark Matter Detection

technologies.desc: These generators appear to somehow draw energy directly from dark matter, providing more ship power than should be possible according to the laws of physics.
technologies.name: Dark Matter Power

technologies.desc: These ship thrusters utilize Dark Matter technology to generate propulsion in a manner that appears to defy numerous laws of physics.
technologies.name: Dark Matter Propulsion

technologies.desc: Primitive encryption systems stand no chance against modern decryption tools.
technologies.name: Quantum Hacking

technologies.desc: The weakest link in any security system are the individuals within it. By modeling their weaknesses in computer simulations we can find novel ways to bypass their security - or trick them into bypassing it for us.
technologies.name: Simulated Social Engineering

technologies.desc: Our operatives can access data from adjacent realities without risking setting off alarms in this reality.
technologies.name: Quasi-Dimensional Reflection

technologies.desc: Many planets exhibit extensive subsurface voids. Subterranean exploration, exploitation, and construction techniques can greatly increase the habitable area of some worlds.
technologies.name: Subterranean Colonization

technologies.desc: A Deep Space Citadel is an armored Starbase designed for maximum defense within a stellar gravity well.
technologies.name: Deep Space Citadel

technologies.desc: A reinforced framework and blast shields with enhanced impact absorption will ensure the structural integrity of the platform even under immense pressure.
technologies.name: Improved Structural Integrity

technologies.desc: Thorough cataloging, gene sequencing, and computer modeling of exobotanical ecosystems, coupled with gene editing and dispersal mechanisms, will allow us to reshape alien plant communities to our liking.
technologies.name: Selective Defoliants

technologies.desc: Establishing new standards for the modeling and construction of destroyers greatly improves the efficiency of the production pipeline.
technologies.name: Standardized Destroyer Patterns

technologies.desc: Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable destroyers.
technologies.name: Improved Destroyer Hulls

technologies.desc: The latest generation of destroyer hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.
technologies.name: Advanced Destroyer Hulls

technologies.desc: While larger than Corvettes, Destroyer hull configurations still make for comparatively nimble gunboats.
technologies.name: Destroyers

technologies.desc: A high-powered suite of external sensors, capable of detecting cloaked fleets.
technologies.name: Detection Array

technologies.desc: Disruptors fire high-energy bolts that weaken and destroy the molecular bonds that hold the target's constituent atoms together. They are capable of passing through shields and armor to wreak havoc directly on enemy hull and crew.
technologies.name: Disruptors

technologies.desc: These upgraded disruptors fire bolts of more destructive ion particles at targets.
technologies.name: Ion Disruptors

technologies.desc: Extremely high-yield disruptors that fire quantum energy charges causing incredible damage to those unfortunate enough to get in their way.
technologies.name: Phase Disruptors

technologies.desc: Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.
technologies.name: Doctrine: Space Combat

technologies.desc: Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.
technologies.name: Doctrine: Reactive Formations

technologies.desc: Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.
technologies.name: Doctrine: Interstellar Warfare

technologies.name: Doctrine: Fluid Fleet Templates

technologies.desc: Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.
technologies.name: Doctrine: Armada Battle Formation

technologies.desc: As extrasolar expeditions become more common, it is important to provide planetside relief for returning fleets.
technologies.name: Doctrine: Fleet Support

technologies.desc: A fleet does not run on zeal alone. To ensure steady access to critical supplies, we should organize our logistics corps into dedicated support vessels.
technologies.name: Doctrine: Support Vessels

technologies.desc: Amateurs talk about tactics. Professionals study logistics. By ensuring our fleets are regularly and efficiently supplied, we can increase the number of vessels we can effectively support.
technologies.name: Doctrine: Interstellar Logistics

technologies.desc: By maintaining a professional corps of fleet liaisons, we can improve communications and the flow of orders throughout the chain of command.
technologies.name: Doctrine: Fleet Liaisons

technologies.desc: The Ether Drake's scales are made up of multiple layers of unique mineral nanostructures. Unorthodox manufacturing techniques allow us to closely emulate these self-repairing structures.
technologies.name: Artificial Dragonscales

technologies.desc: Upgraded artificial units have an expanded movement range equal to that of most organics. Their neural processors have also been greatly improved.
technologies.name: Artificial Specialists

technologies.desc: Allows us to shoot our energy stockpile at targeted systems
technologies.name: Stellar Cannon

technologies.desc: A Dyson Sphere fully envelops a given star, converting all solar output directly to Energy Credits.
technologies.name: Dyson Sphere

technologies.desc: An array of interlinked satellites, the Dyson Swarm is designed to improve the output of stellar deposits.
technologies.name: Dyson Swarm

technologies.desc: Farming techniques can be further refined through sophisticated computer simulations of different environments and weather patterns. This allows for more predictable crop yields.
technologies.name: Eco Simulation

technologies.desc: By adapting planetary ecosystems to large-scale environmental changes we can turn terraformation into a less disruptive process.
technologies.name: Ecological Adaptation

technologies.desc: Improved algorithms for processing and organizing vast amounts of data has streamlined decision-making and information-sharing throughout the empire.
technologies.name: Effective Bureaucracy

technologies.desc: Initiative and some measure of ambition must be promoted in our autonomous leader units, while still making certain that they do not stray too far from the directives of the core intelligence.
technologies.name: Embodied Dynamism

technologies.desc: Advances in computing technology have given us new ways to protect our data from prying eyes.
technologies.name: Quantum Firewalls

technologies.desc: Further advances in unstable entanglement have given us new ways to prevent unauthorized intrusions into our databases.
technologies.name: Simultaneous-Collapse Storage

technologies.desc: Our latest advances in encryption exploit recently discovered quirks of physics to require inputting a specialized key before it has been generated.
technologies.name: Negative-Time Keys

technologies.desc: These heavy energy weapons fire focused particle beams that cause massive damage. The size of the emitter arrays limits their use to battleships and titans.
technologies.name: Particle Lances

technologies.desc: A more powerful version of the particle lance, this weapon fires a tachyon beam of immense power. Like its predecessor, its use is limited to battleships and titans.
technologies.name: Tachyon Lances

technologies.desc: These energy projectiles consist of tightly concentrated protons capable of causing immense damage to the hull of enemy ships.
technologies.name: Proton Launchers

technologies.desc: Upgraded energy projectiles that rely on neutrons instead of protons for their destructive power.
technologies.name: Neutron Launchers

technologies.desc: Further breakthroughs in mechanical engineering required us to descend to the nanometric scale. We are now able to manipulate physical systems in never-before-seen ways.
technologies.name: Nanomechanics

technologies.desc: Much as organic neurons reforge lost connections by means of axonal sprouting, these circuits are capable of self-overhaul. Even the simplest computing systems are now expected to evolve while in use.
technologies.name: Self-Connecting Circuitry

technologies.desc: The quantum mechanical properties of these materials hold the key to superposition states, a revolutionary development for both material and industrial science.
technologies.name: Supersolid Materials

technologies.desc: Sedatives based on a rare enzyme enable enhanced cryosleep, greatly improving organic species' tolerance of long-distance space travel.
technologies.name: Enhanced Cryosleep Sedatives

technologies.desc: While producing average results in standard tests, the accuracy of Enigmatic Decoder's prediction algorithms seemingly increases as the target's flight path grows more erratic.
technologies.name: Enigmatic Decoder

technologies.desc: The Enigmatic Encoder scrambles flight path data according to some indeterminable design before feeding it back to fleet command.
technologies.name: Enigmatic Encoder

technologies.desc: Advanced DNA methylation techniques allow for functionally significant alterations to be made to arbitrary genomes.
technologies.name: Epigenetic Triggers

technologies.desc: A luxurious resort complex for high ranking corporate officers. Here they can sample the local culture in a high security environment.
technologies.name: Executive Leisure Program

technologies.desc: When survival itself is at stake, the very concept of war loses its meaning. These campaigns are waged not for dominion, but to secure the continued existence of our civilization.
technologies.name: Existential Campaigns

technologies.desc: Exotic Gas can be produced artificially, but it is a difficult process that requires advanced refinery equipment.
technologies.name: Exotic Gas Refining

technologies.desc: Solitary Science Ships can break out of the naturally-occurring hyperlanes and attempt to navigate to known but otherwise unreachable destinations.
technologies.name: Speculative Hyperlane Breaching

technologies.desc: Applying 5th-dimensional energy manipulation principles on lower dimensional planes allows for the creation of powerful energy weapons.
technologies.name: Extradimensional Weaponry

technologies.desc: Our administrative requirements will likewise expand as our mastery of advanced technology evolves. We must adeptly cater to the demands of our burgeoning empire.
technologies.name: Fractal Administration Processes

technologies.desc: Our technology now surpasses any administrative requirement. The expertise needed to seamlessly govern a galactic empire is firmly within our reach.
technologies.name: Quantic Administration Processes

technologies.desc: This center anticipates and fulfills material desires using an advanced procurement algorithm, delivering satisfaction before the populace realizes their wants.
technologies.name: Affluence Emporium

technologies.desc: This center effortlessly materializes the most outlandish desires at a moment's notice.
technologies.name: Affluence Center

technologies.desc: An avant-garde assembly complex manned by expert Roboticists, this facility transcends conventional bounds, meticulously realizing the forefront of robotic innovation.
technologies.name: Robot Manufacturing Nexus

technologies.desc: A marvel in engineering, this facility's quantic assembly line uses entanglement converters to craft machine parts down to the most minute detail. Not a single atom is misplaced.
technologies.name: Robot Quantum Production Hub

technologies.desc: Molecular-Revitalization Institutes delve deep into cellular intricacies to amplify the effectiveness of medical treatments, significantly improving the quality and longevity of the populations' health.
technologies.name: Molecular-Revitalization Institute

technologies.desc: The Bioregeneration Institute, at the pinnacle of medical technology, pioneers groundbreaking bio-regenerative therapies, continuously redefining the boundaries of life extension.
technologies.name: Bioregeneration Institute

technologies.desc: This floating city, propelled by state-of-the-art anti-gravity technology, provides an idyllic haven for its inhabitants.
technologies.name: Sky Dome

technologies.desc: Suspended by gravimetric nullification, these domes transcend physical limitations, while advanced life support systems seamlessly cater to inhabitants' needs.
technologies.name: Empyrean Dome

technologies.desc: These immense entertainment sectors are at the forefront of recreation and leisure. Brainwave readers allow for instantaneous and personalized virtual getaways.
technologies.name: Virtual Bliss Plaza

technologies.desc: A colossal culmination of entertainment, this nexus transcends conventional limits, where dreams materialize before desires are realized.
technologies.name: Omni-Bliss Nexus

technologies.desc: This fabricator's technology achieves flawless conversion from energy to matter.
technologies.name: Dimensional Replicator

technologies.desc: This advanced fabricator seamlessly tunnels into the fabric of dimensional space, extracting valuable resources.
technologies.name: Dimensional Fabricator

technologies.desc: This forge's production speed is limited only by the quantity of resources loaded into it.
technologies.name: Hyper-Forge

technologies.desc: The expansive nano-replicator bays in this forge transform raw materials into advanced alloys with marvelous efficiency.
technologies.name: Auto-Forge

technologies.desc: This colossal planetary defense complex has numerous armories and layers of shielding. Only a highly specialized siege force could breach its defenses.
technologies.name: Aspis Bastion

technologies.desc: This monumental planetary defense complex protects with countless armories and shielding; the planet's mountains will crumble before its defenses.
technologies.name: Aegis Complex

technologies.desc: This nexus boasts state-of-the-art equipment and an unprecedented staff capacity, ushering in an era where quantum theories are not just explored but harnessed for groundbreaking innovation.
technologies.name: Quantum Innovation Nexus

technologies.desc: This building is the apex of scientific advancement and proves this is an era of boundless innovation.
technologies.name: Transcendental Innovation Department

technologies.desc: Dominating the skyline, these towering spires cast shadows across the bustling trade districts below.
technologies.name: Galactic Commerce Hub

technologies.desc: Reigning supreme in the galactic economy, the colossal spires of this trade district can be seen from orbit.
technologies.name: Interstellar Commerce Nexus

technologies.desc: This mining plant can find minerals anywhere in this planet's mantle using quantum tunneling technology to bore through solid materials without physical contact.
technologies.name: Quantum Drilling Plant

technologies.desc: This mining hub can extract minerals anywhere down to the planet's outer core using quantum tunneling technology to bore through solid or liquid materials without physical contact.
technologies.name: Quantum Drilling Hub

technologies.desc: Replication technology swiftly conjures up novel flavors on command.
technologies.name: Nourishment Complex

technologies.desc: Every conceivable flavor can be replicated within these walls.
technologies.name: Nourishment Center

technologies.desc: This massive judicial complex seamlessly intertwines courts and law enforcement.
technologies.name: Justice Complex

technologies.desc: The zenith of legal institutions, this colossal edifice is a monument to justice, harboring courts, holding facilities, and correctional facilities that will redeem even the most hardened criminals.
technologies.name: Ziggurat of Justice

technologies.desc: The depot influences a portion of subspace where the distance between molecules is reduced, effectively shrinking anything stored there. Living beings are forbidden from entering it.
technologies.name: Shrinkspace Depot

technologies.desc: By creating a localized pocket dimension, we can hold nearly endless resources.
technologies.name: Extra-Dimensional Depot

technologies.desc: Capturing the entire energy output from this singularity is an engineering marvel.
technologies.name: Class-3 Singularity

technologies.desc: This singularity's power output challenges the laws of physics, yet the containment fields hold with unwavering stability.
technologies.name: Class-4 Singularity

technologies.desc: A Federation must be more than goodwill and shared ambition. This code provides the groundwork for a unified interstellar order, ensuring cooperation and stability among its members.
technologies.name: Federation Code

technologies.desc: This energy source generates power for ships through induced fission, but it also produces harmful nuclear waste.
technologies.name: Fission Power

technologies.desc: Gun batteries that fire shrapnel rounds at close range. They are particularly lethal to enemy strike craft, but can also defend against missiles.
technologies.name: Flak Battery

technologies.desc: Upgraded flak batteries with new, more powerful shrapnel rounds.
technologies.name: Flak Cannons

technologies.desc: Predictive tracking algorithms and even more powerful rounds make these batteries incredibly lethal to enemy strike craft.
technologies.name: Flak Artillery

technologies.desc: Improved food processing techniques will lead to better preservation methods and less spoilage.
technologies.name: Food Processing

technologies.desc: New cryopreservation and protein resequencing methods will make food processing much more efficient.
technologies.name: Advanced Food Processing

technologies.desc: The colonization of alien worlds has opened up an entirely new field of biomedical research.
technologies.name: Genetic Healthcare

technologies.desc: As our empire grows, so does our understanding of biology. Advanced medical treatments on a cellular level have allowed for significant advancements in biological population health.
technologies.name: Cyto-Revitalization

technologies.desc: Gravity well projectors can be used to create localized pockets of space where safe entry into hyperspace is impossible. The immense power requirements and the size of the projectors prohibits their use on anything smaller than a space station.
technologies.name: FTL Inhibition

technologies.desc: Nuclear fusion processes generate a great amount of power for ships, but without many of the risks associated with fission power.
technologies.name: Fusion Power

technologies.desc: The administrative needs of a star empire are as numerous as they are complex. We will rise to the occasion.
technologies.name: Galactic Administration

technologies.desc: Our future lies in the sea of stars.
technologies.name: Stellar Expansion

technologies.desc: The history of our galaxy warrants proper preservation in order to learn from those who came before us. An archive on the grandest scale would fit such a purpose.
technologies.name: Galactic Archivism

technologies.desc: Multiple administrative strata efficiently surface only the most vital information to the upper levels of government.
technologies.name: Galactic Bureaucracy

technologies.desc: Further improvements to administration grant an extended power projection across the stars, and the military clout needed to enforce our demands.
technologies.name: Galactic Campaigns

technologies.desc: By engaging in free trade of goods and services we allow for a more specialized economy, where an individual can excel in a narrow field and trade for their needs.
technologies.name: Galactic Markets

technologies.desc: Voidspawn eggs have evolved to withstand the harsh conditions of space by absorbing and conserving energy from their nearest star.
technologies.name: Gargantuan Evolution

technologies.desc: The ability to reactivate the derelict Gateway stations that can be found scattered throughout the galaxy has the potential to dramatically shorten travel times.
technologies.name: Gateway Activation

technologies.desc: The construction of new Gateway stations enables us to build a fast-travel network that could revolutionize interstellar travel.
technologies.name: Gateway Construction

technologies.desc: Gene Banks filter and curate available genomes for deployment in clones.
technologies.name: Gene Banks

technologies.desc: Sophisticated genetic engineering of crops helps increase yield and further improves both taste and nutrient levels.
technologies.name: Gene Crops

technologies.desc: Stricter control of RNA and protein production on the cellular level.
technologies.name: Targeted Gene Expressions

technologies.desc: Nucleotide purification techniques allow for the isolation and refinement of particularly desirable genetic traits.
technologies.name: Gene Seed Purification

technologies.desc: Making gene-editing tools widely available is sure to have a positive impact on our development as a species.
technologies.name: Gene Tailoring

technologies.desc: Mapping the genome of an individual through the sequencing of their DNA opens up for tailored medical treatments and therapies.
technologies.name: Genome Mapping

technologies.desc: By exposing the biosphere of a planet to molecular radiation decay, we promote the growth of certain resources while turning the world into a toxic wasteland.
technologies.name: Georadiation Terraforming

technologies.desc: Through glandular biological tailoring we can change the environmental tolerance of a species to suit our needs.
technologies.name: Glandular Acclimation

technologies.desc: The strategic value of a good defense remains as relevant today as it was to our predecessors in the far distant past. Technology does not render fortifications obsolete - it merely changes their requirements.
technologies.name: Global Defense Grid

technologies.desc: Planets are big and production sites are often separated by vast distances. A coherent strategy for making certain that everyone is pulling in the same direction is often needed.
technologies.name: Global Production Strategy

technologies.desc: A bid for interplanetary resource pools and more flexible research grants.
technologies.name: Interplanetary Research Initiative

technologies.desc: Increases the amount of Space Fauna captured by Gravity Snares by 1
technologies.name: Micro Singularity Enhancements

technologies.desc: Increases the amount of Space Fauna captured by Gravity Snares by 1
technologies.name: Gravity Manipulation Optimization

technologies.name: Containment System Improvement

technologies.desc: Localized concentrations of quantum mass can be used to create short bursts of extreme gravity. If manipulated correctly, such a gravitational force could theoretically capture and contain a creature of any size without harm.
technologies.name: Gravity Snares

technologies.desc: There are many alien empires who would gladly seize our worlds for themselves. We must be prepared for them, should the worst come to pass.
technologies.name: Ground Defense Planning

technologies.desc: The construction of Growth Chambers enables the organic cultivation of biological ships within the fleet.
technologies.name: Growth Chamber

technologies.desc: The enhanced efficiency and capacity of Growth Chambers accelerates the cultivation of biological ships by refining their organic designs.
technologies.name: Advanced Growth Chamber

technologies.desc: Allows the construction of largely self-sustaining Orbital Habitats.
technologies.name: Orbital Habitats

technologies.desc: Our early habitats were primitive things compared to the efficient designs we can now develop.
technologies.name: Habitat Expansion

technologies.desc: Years of improvements to our Orbital Habitats have led us to create newer more effective designs.
technologies.name: Advanced Space Habitation

technologies.desc: These facilities nurture large biological ships, feeding them through advanced nutrient infusion to ensure resilience and combat readiness.
technologies.name: Standardized Harbinger Incubation

technologies.desc: Refined facilities employ sophisticated bio-engineering techniques to accelerate growth and enhance structural integrity. The resulting vessels feature improved endurance and increased combat efficiency.
technologies.name: Improved Harbinger Development

technologies.desc: Advanced incubation systems produce biological ships of exceptional durability and firepower. Genetic fine-tuning and superior growth environments create vessels capable of dominating the battlefield with unmatched resilience.
technologies.name: Advanced Harbinger Development

technologies.desc: Harbingers represent a significant leap in bio-engineered warfare, blending formidable firepower with the resilience of living technology. These ships serve as the backbone of the fleet.
technologies.name: Harbingers

technologies.desc: Physical reminders of how far we have come both instill a reverence for past achievements and bolster ambitions for the future.
technologies.name: Heritage Sites

technologies.desc: By clustering networks of macroscopic synaptic nodes, maximum meganeuron transmission per available surface area can be attained.
technologies.name: Clustered Synapses

technologies.desc: The will of the Hive will be further strengthened and coordinated with the expansion and development of a massive nervous center of meganeurons.
technologies.name: Confluence of Thought

technologies.desc: Through the development of macroscopic synaptic nodes, the will of the Hive will be strengthened.
technologies.name: Synaptic Structures

technologies.desc: Pioneering use of holographic technology allows for the creation of artificial environments that seem as authentic as the real world. It is the next step of immersive entertainment.
technologies.name: Holo-Entertainment

technologies.desc: Seeing is believing, and belief begets reality.
technologies.name: Holographic Rituals

technologies.desc: The ability to alter a planet's weather patterns to suppress destructive weather phenomena will make residential buildings easier to maintain and open up new areas for habitation.
technologies.name: Weather Control Systems

technologies.desc: With directional gravity technology, buildings on the surface of planets can reach higher than ever before without risking structural collapse. The sky is the limit!
technologies.name: Anti-Gravity Engineering

technologies.desc: Through the establishment of weather-controlled rural communes, we can support a larger population without disrupting our agrarian way of life.
technologies.name: Agrarian Utopias

technologies.desc: Hydroponics Farming in a controlled environment allows for crops to be grown in climates where farming would normally be impossible.
technologies.name: Hydroponics Farming

technologies.desc: Like the strands of a spider web, the extra-dimensional realm of hyperspace runs between the gravity wells of most stars. Faster than light travel is theoretically possible along these hyperlanes.
technologies.name: Hyperspace Travel

technologies.desc: We have identified the existence of points in space where a ship expends less energy to "breach" their way into a hyperlane. This will lead to a new generation of hyper drives.
technologies.name: Hyperlane Breach Points

technologies.desc: A new generation of hyper drives capable of accessing the subspace slipstreams that are present within hyperspace. This leads to dramatically improved drive performance.
technologies.name: Hyperspace Slipstreams

technologies.desc: Traveling across hyperlanes can be hazardous for spaceborne life, but we are able to enhance their capabilities.
technologies.name: Hyperdrive Bio-integration

technologies.desc: These massive entertainment complexes is where dreams come true. Shopping malls, restaurants, amusement parks, virtual arcades, and more. You dream it - we are it!
technologies.name: Hyper-Entertainment Forum

technologies.desc: Hyper Relays form a chain of structures built outside the gravity well of systems, allowing fast travel from relay to relay rather than requiring transit to established hyperlane entrances.
technologies.name: Hyper Relays

technologies.desc: Not all research into faster-than-light communication channels produces useful results, but some outcomes may find new purpose in bringing our people together.
technologies.name: Local Hypercommunication

technologies.desc: We will be able to copy the identity and memories of a Synthetic into a new mechanical body. The copies have predictable skill sets but make for stale conversation.
technologies.name: Identity Copies

technologies.desc: Merging the identities and memories of two or more Synthetics into a mechanical body will create new, somewhat unique individuals.
technologies.name: Identity Fusion

technologies.desc: We will be able to initialize an identity kernel and provide it with a virtual childhood. While expensive, we can simulate the optimal experiences to generate productive personalities.
technologies.name: Identity Initialization

technologies.desc: We can improve the artificial growth processes established in our hatcheries, accelerating the early developmental stages in order to create more mature clones.
technologies.name: Improved Incubators

technologies.desc: Large-scale industrial farms growing nutrient-rich produce allows a civilization to grow its population manifold.
technologies.name: Industrial Agriculture

technologies.desc: This nexus of weather communication mitigates the harm done by cosmic weather disasters. Production will suffer less from a passing galactic tempest.
technologies.name: Planetary Storm Negation

technologies.desc: Improving upon basic exoskeletal suits, these integrated cybernetic implants make the user more resistant to harmful environmental effects.
technologies.name: Integrated Cybernetics

technologies.desc: With new planetary markets comes new opportunities for commerce. Business will be booming.
technologies.name: Interplanetary Commerce

technologies.desc: A meeting place for galactic powers, increasing immigration attraction and global opinion of us.
technologies.name: Interstellar Assembly

technologies.desc: A well-oiled war machine is the key to exerting influence on a galactic scale. Backed by the might of our military, we can lay claim to almost anything we want.
technologies.name: Interstellar Campaigns

technologies.desc: As we journeyed into the cosmos and ventured beyond our home system, we also entered a new era of economics. New markets are appearing a startling rate, and economic theorists are struggling to keep up.
technologies.name: Interstellar Economics

technologies.desc: A body of knowledge regarding combat behaviors is useless without a strong code governing its use.
technologies.name: Interstellar Fleet Traditions

technologies.desc: A mobile space base of unparalleled proportions, the Juggernaut ship class takes offensive warfare to a whole new level.
technologies.name: Juggernaut

technologies.desc: A groundbreaking technological marvel, the Jump Drive shreds the local space-time continuum and rearranges it on the quantum level to be identical to that of the target destination - and thus the ship appears to near-instantly "jump" from system to system.
technologies.name: Jump Drive

technologies.desc: Very long-range artillery capable of hurling powerful rounds over extreme distances with a large degree of accuracy.
technologies.name: Kinetic Battery

technologies.desc: An even more powerful long-range, ship-based artillery cannon, equipped with a new barrel and an upgraded fire control computer.
technologies.name: Kinetic Artillery

technologies.desc: Laser weapons fire focused beams of light at targets, causing damage through the generation of intense heat.
technologies.name: Red Lasers

technologies.desc: More powerful than red lasers, these blue variants emit electromagnetic radiation at a wavelength that appears blue or violet to most organics.
technologies.name: Blue Lasers

technologies.desc: Ultraviolet lasers are an updated and more powerful version of their blue predecessors. Accurate and destructive, these weapons are capable of inflicting great damage.
technologies.name: UV Lasers

technologies.desc: These lasers have a shorter wavelength than UV-based laser weaponry, but are even more destructive.
technologies.name: X-Ray Lasers

technologies.desc: The electromagnetic radiation emitted by gamma lasers is of an extremely high frequency. Their destructive potential is unmatched in the field of laser weapons.
technologies.name: Gamma Lasers

technologies.desc: Calculating hyperspatial supply chains is complex. Rerouting some processing power to the task will help even the largest fleet to delve deeper into enemy territory.
technologies.name: Synaptic Cogitator

technologies.desc: Dedicated facilities organize the maintenance of the Lathe's critical components, allowing us to support more chips and a healthier network environment.
technologies.name: Synaptic Sustainer

technologies.desc: The Lathe has been designed to preserve its installed Neural Chips, keeping them productive for as long as possible. The overclocker can override these commands, resulting in a higher and faster output, but it comes with an increased failure rate.
technologies.name: Synaptic Overclocker

technologies.desc: The organic components of the network are especially vulnerable to energetic fluctuations, which can cause rapid axonal degeneration. The Preserver strives to reduce these fluctuations to protect the Synaptic Lathe's frailer parts.
technologies.name: Synaptic Preserver

technologies.desc: Resonators harness and redirect the cognitive potential of stray thoughts and autonomic systems, leading every single chip to increase the efficiency of its closest processing neighbors.
technologies.name: Synaptic Resonator

technologies.desc: While the primary purpose of the validator's specialized functions is to help formulate infinity theses, it can also be applied to more general aspects of computing.
technologies.name: Synaptic Validator

technologies.desc: Utilizing the received knowledge seized from Leviathans, we now have access to new improvements for our frames.
technologies.name: Leviathan Tech Genesis

technologies.desc: The L-Gates defy our current understanding of subspace mechanics. This must be remedied before they can be opened for travel.
technologies.name: L-Gate Activation

technologies.desc: The Empire lives, the Empire breathes. We may make up its body, but it is not for the left hand to know what the right hand is doing.
technologies.name: The Living State

technologies.desc: The utilization of basic slime-spawned lifeforms as willing test subjects greatly improves research efficiency.
technologies.name: Living Test Subjects

technologies.desc: Any civilization with a long enough history has examples of great wonders built by forgotten ancients which can no longer be replicated. Luckily for us we have documented these great ancients when they appeared on pre-FTL worlds.
technologies.name: Lost Building Methods

technologies.desc: With pre-programmed nano-circuits, many consumer products can be rapidly assembled in fabricators.
technologies.name: Nano-Circuit Assembly

technologies.desc: These kiosks can replicate any pre-approved object if its pattern has been stored within their memory banks.
technologies.name: Replicator Kiosks

technologies.desc: These devastating appendages incorporate layered organic structures to enhance durability and cutting power, shredding even the toughest defenses.
technologies.name: Composite Mandibles

technologies.desc: These mandibles possess unparalleled sharpness and resilience, capable of slicing through advanced alloys with unnerving precision.
technologies.name: Crystalline Mandibles

technologies.desc: We must have to courage to seize our fate and make true what was always meant to be.
technologies.name: Manifest Destiny

technologies.desc: An enormous mass accelerator cannon that can only be placed in a spinal mount and fires monstrously powerful rounds over vast distances.
technologies.name: Mega Cannon

technologies.desc: An even more powerful mass accelerator cannon that can rip through even the toughest shields.
technologies.name: Giga Cannon

technologies.desc: These electromagnetic projectile launchers use magnets to accelerate armor-piercing rounds towards targets at high speeds.
technologies.name: Mass Drivers

technologies.desc: Coilguns are more powerful versions of the early mass drivers, using electromagnetic coils to rapidly accelerate projectiles towards targets.
technologies.name: Coilguns

technologies.desc: The latest in electromagnetic accelerators, railguns use twin parallel rails to fire projectiles at incredible speeds.
technologies.name: Railguns

technologies.desc: A new version of the venerable railgun, with sturdier rails and an enhanced power supply. These weapons are even more powerful and accurate than their predecessors.
technologies.name: Advanced Railguns

technologies.desc: This updated version of the old coilgun design is even more destructive than the latest railgun designs. It is capable of launching projectiles with incredible accuracy and speed.
technologies.name: Gauss Cannons

technologies.desc: Orbital systems of mirrors and shades can effect dramatic changes in planetary climates, when managed properly.
technologies.name: Climate Control Network

technologies.desc: The psionic energy of the Shroud adjoins every point in the physical galaxy. The Materiality Engine exploits this interface, making it possible to reach across dimensions and materialize valuable components and resources.
technologies.name: Materiality Engine

technologies.desc: The Matter Decompressor lenses a black hole's gravity, forming a drill of gravitational forces to retrieve Minerals from the singularity.
technologies.name: Matter Decompressor

technologies.desc: These incubation chambers accelerate the gestation of embryonic warships within nutrient-dense biopods. Though rudimentary, they mark the first step toward a fleet that is not constructed, but grown.
technologies.name: Standardized Mauler Incubation

technologies.desc: Refined incubation processes reduce maturation times and improve structural integrity of organic starships. Enhanced nutrient delivery systems and genetic tuning ensure the vessels are both swift and resilient.
technologies.name: Improved Mauler Development

technologies.desc: These facilities yield vessels of unparalleled vitality and adaptive capacity. Optimized genetic matrices and advanced biotechnological support guarantee unmatched performance in the void.
technologies.name: Advanced Mauler Development

technologies.desc: Breakthroughs in bio-engineering have allowed the growth of space-faring, FTL-capable craft with military applications.
technologies.name: Maulers

technologies.desc: The application of mechanical engineering to mineral extraction is a fundamental requirement for any industrial society.
technologies.name: Mechanized Mining

technologies.desc: An artistic beacon on a stellar scale, this installation inspires and represents the spirit of its creators.
technologies.name: Mega Art Installation

technologies.desc: Advanced templates allow us to drastically increase the assembly of new units.
technologies.name: Mega-Assembly Systems

technologies.desc: To complete construction projects of truly staggering scales we must first achieve a fundamental understanding of both the engineering and resource storage requirements for such megastructures.
technologies.name: Mega-Engineering

technologies.desc: A zero-G construction yard of overwhelming proportion, capable of performing several space ship assembly projects simultaneously.
technologies.name: Mega Shipyard

technologies.desc: Improvements to the metabolic gases within our hatcheries will further mature each specimen before it is brought into this world.
technologies.name: Metabolic Gases

technologies.desc: Microscopic tools that can assist our replication units in creating the more complex circuitry needed for new drones.
technologies.name: Micro-Replicators

technologies.desc: Military Arkships are the armored core of a nomadic empire. Purpose-built for combat, they carry devastating firepower wherever the fleet travels.
technologies.name: Military Arkships

technologies.desc: The Betharian minerals appear to have originated from singular source, but were scattered across the galaxy millennia ago. The minerals are most often encountered as pebble-sized clusters, and are highly flammable.
technologies.name: Betharian Refining

technologies.desc: This exotic substance has many properties that seemingly defy the laws of physics. Harvestable concentrations can only be found near Black Holes or in certain nebulas.
technologies.name: Dark Matter Drawing

technologies.desc: Pockets of Exotic Gas are rare and often inaccessible by conventional means. Such deposits can only be reached by using special extractor technology.
technologies.name: Exotic Gas Extraction

technologies.desc: Mining and processing the rare living metals is exceedingly difficult, but successful application of the mutable alloys yields incomparable advantages.
technologies.name: Living Metal

technologies.desc: Mining these crystals without damaging or even destroying them is an extremely delicate process. It requires advanced equipment capable of pinpoint precision.
technologies.name: Rare Crystal Mining

technologies.desc: Volatile Motes are fickle particles that are dangerous to work with. In order to safely harvest them without setting off a chain-reaction of explosions, energy fields must be used to stabilize the motes.
technologies.name: Mote Stabilization

technologies.desc: An extremely rare aerosol of exotic particles. It has been deposited on a number of worlds through meteor impacts, but its true origin is a mystery. If ingested by psionically-gifted individuals, Zro acts as a very potent (and addictive) drug that enhances Psi abilities.
technologies.name: Zro Distillation

technologies.desc: Optimal processing of mined materials have allowed us to reach new levels of efficiency.
technologies.name: Mineral Purification

technologies.desc: Second-stage processing of pseudo-refined minerals allow for more efficient storage and transportation.
technologies.name: Advanced Mineral Purification

technologies.desc: New fracking techniques will allow us to tap into previously unattainable pockets of geothermal resources deep beneath the planet's crust.
technologies.name: Geothermal Fracking

technologies.desc: These massive drills are needed to access the rich mineral deposits that can often be found close to a planet's core.
technologies.name: Deep Core Mining

technologies.desc: Advanced spectrometry combines with fracking techniques and chemical flushing to rapidly exploit shallow and mid-depth deposits.
technologies.name: Mineral Isolation

technologies.desc: Using intense-focus lenses in combination with an oscillating firing frequency help create lasers strong enough to mine asteroids, or shoot down hostiles.
technologies.name: Mining Drone Lasers

technologies.desc: Space-to-space missiles equipped with high-yield nuclear warheads. Although based on old pre-space technology, these crude fire-and-forget weapons can be surprisingly effective at range.
technologies.name: Nuclear Missiles

technologies.desc: These updated space-to-space missiles have more powerful fusion warheads and improved flight performance.
technologies.name: Fusion Missiles

technologies.desc: Advanced missiles equipped with very powerful antimatter warheads. A new and improved guidance system gives them a better chance of finding their targets.
technologies.name: Antimatter Missiles

technologies.desc: The latest version of space-to-space missile, this upgraded variant has an immensely powerful warhead that draws its energy from a zero point vacuum.
technologies.name: Quantum Missiles

technologies.desc: These highly advanced missiles are equipped with limited onboard AI pilots that substantially improve their performance and ability to track targets.
technologies.name: Marauder Missiles

technologies.desc: Streamlined starbase construction procedures, using modular designs, will reduce the present build cost and time.
technologies.name: Modular Engineering

technologies.desc: From its cradle as a purely pharmaceutical venture, advancements in our understanding of the morphogenetic field allow for direct, subconscious interfaces with organic units.
technologies.name: Morphogenetic Field Mastery

technologies.desc: With the advent of clean fusion, automation, and matter compression technologies, it was only a matter of time before mountain top removal became mountain range removal.
technologies.name: Planetary Resurfacing

technologies.desc: Using programmable nanites to assist in the construction of new robotic units will allow for more advanced models that are equipped with an even greater array of subsystems.
technologies.name: Nanite Assemblers

technologies.desc: Highly advanced autocannons capable of ejecting shells that explode into a cloud of nanites at the target, overwhelming shields and chewing through hull sections.
technologies.name: Nanite Autocannon

technologies.desc: Improving upon previous designs by launching canisters of nanites capable of eating away at strike craft, these flak batteries are the bane of any fighter pilot.
technologies.name: Nanite Flak Battery

technologies.desc: A highly effective hull auto-repair system comprised of billions of microscopic nanomachines was found among the smoking remains of the Scavenger, and has been repurposed for our uses. Whether the Scavenger pilfered this system from an ancient derelict, or was originally constructed with it remains unknown.
technologies.name: Nanite Repair System

technologies.desc: Cetana's advanced nanite systems will tirelessly repair and refresh our ships at a rate far beyond our current capabilities.
technologies.name: Cetana's Nanites

technologies.desc: The mass-production of these rare resources require particularly capable nanites.
