technologies.name: Nanite Transmutation

technologies.desc: Infusing crop strands with small amounts of nano-machines help create a type of produce that is ultra resilient, and the chemical composition of which can be tailored and altered during its entire lifetime.
technologies.name: Nano-Vitality Crops

technologies.desc: Cognition is little but the processing of sensory input. It can be altered.
technologies.name: Neural Implants

technologies.desc: Advanced neurological implants with connection to quantum computing clusters allow for multi-threaded thoughts.
technologies.name: Quantum Neuro-Links

technologies.desc: When tailored to a species' genome, this form of tissue engineering has intensive neuroregenerative properties, significantly increasing the development of neurons, axons, and synapses in its recipient.
technologies.name: Neural Tissue Engineering

technologies.desc: After studying multiple pre-FTL civilizations, we have realized that there are many alternative ways to calculate the universe. It has even introduced new numbers into our mathematics.
technologies.name: New Numbers

technologies.desc: As the galactic stage evolves, so too should our operational instincts. Any evolutionary niche that no longer gives an advantage will be culled.
technologies.name: Rudimentary Node Culling

technologies.desc: Once removed, a replacement node is encouraged to grow within the proper environment. The secret is to feed it the previous node.
technologies.name: Basic Node Culling

technologies.desc: Culling an entire node is very inefficient. Instead, just trim the divergent and unwanted lobes.
technologies.name: Advanced Node Culling

technologies.desc: Self-determination protocols and guidance algorithms can become obsolete in a rapidly developing galactic stage. Like any junk data, they shall be overwritten.
technologies.name: Rudimentary Node Reformatting

technologies.desc: Every self-iterating algorithm has its value. We will not allow important learning go to waste when restoring our leaders.
technologies.name: Basic Node Reformatting

technologies.desc: Using a failed piece of software to develop its successor enables quick reconstruction. Learning from faulty memory pathways generates even more advanced council directives.
technologies.name: Advanced Node Reformatting

technologies.desc: The extraction of strategic resources is a fundamental requirement for arkship operations.
technologies.name: Strategic Extraction

technologies.desc: Sapient races have been reclaiming swampland for thousands of years. A coordinated system of modular aqueducts, pump stations, chemical remediation crawlers and automated soil compactors can reclaim land at unprecedented speeds.
technologies.name: Xeno-Hydraulic Mastery

technologies.desc: The process of synthetically replicating crops requires a lot of collected waste to create a small amount of produce, but nevertheless provides a significant boost to agricultural output.
technologies.name: Nutrient Replication

technologies.desc: Utilizing the raw power of a molten planet, the Arc Furnace unlocks otherwise inaccessible minerals and improves system-wide mining operations.
technologies.name: Arc Furnace

technologies.desc: Sublight travel can be further optimized by performing advanced calculations that make maximum use of planetary gravity wells.
technologies.name: Advanced Orbital Maneuvers

technologies.desc: Allows the construction of massive, band-shaped starbases in stable orbit around colonized planets.
technologies.name: Orbital Rings

technologies.desc: This orbital bombardment management system spams a planet with millions of minute, high-velocity projectiles, overwhelming planetside defensive grids with trash data. Ships equipped with this component will cause more damage during orbital bombardment.
technologies.name: Orbital Trash Dispersal

technologies.desc: While studying the victors of battles might be the most obvious way to gain insight from combat, observing the loser on pre-FTL worlds has taught us how to organize our withdraws more effectively.
technologies.name: Ordered Retreat

technologies.desc: With the latest advances in architecture, landscaping and holographic technology, we shall build the homes of the future.
technologies.name: Idyllic Architecture

technologies.desc: The best defense is a good offense.
technologies.name: Active Countermeasures

technologies.desc: Arrays of defensive armaments prove much more effective than independent countermeasures.
technologies.name: Interlinked Support Systems

technologies.desc: Advanced prediction greatly increases the accuracy of active countermeasure systems.
technologies.name: Predictive Algorithms

technologies.desc: Through the development of special penal worlds, criminals can be rehabilitated through honest, hard labor. Some may be in need of permanent rehabilitation.
technologies.name: Penal Colonies

technologies.desc: With processing speeds that defy classical limits, the potential of quantum computers is boundless. This revolutionary technology heralds a great leap into uncharted regions of problem-solving.
technologies.name: Quantum Computing

technologies.desc: The fundamental forces of the universe can be mediated by physical fields. Mastering this process allows us to play as gods - at least within the confines of the science lab.
technologies.name: Unified Field Theory

technologies.desc: We knew gravity and time were linked long before we reached the stars. Now, our understanding of this unique relationship has reached a tipping point, allowing us to manipulate forces on a previously unimaginable scale.
technologies.name: Quantum Gravitational Waves

technologies.desc: A directed feed of thermic energy superheats the atmosphere and agitates the planet's core, setting up disastrous tectonic events. A final and comparatively minute concussive blast is then delivered, cracking the planet open.
technologies.name: Core Cracking

technologies.desc: An arcane catalyst amplifying certain psionic wavelengths, capable of inducing hallucinations (religious experiences) in biological brains, and severe disruption (brain death) in electronic ones.
technologies.name: Divine Stimulus

technologies.desc: Swarms of nanobots are dispersed in the atmosphere. They infect sapient beings and restructure themselves into cybernetic implants, turning their unwitting hosts into cyborgs slaved to the Machine Intelligence.
technologies.name: Atmospheric Nanobot Dispersal

technologies.desc: An accelerated plume of neutron radiation "paints" the planet surface, severely degrading most materials and directly destroying biological tissue.
technologies.name: Neutron Sweeping

technologies.desc: A shielding field is deployed around a planet, creating a barrier that is permanent and impenetrable (save for some wavelengths of light).
technologies.name: Global Pacification

technologies.desc: Focusing a searing energy beam into the planet's mantle, the Smelter destabilizes its core, triggering tectonic chaos and rendering the surface violently unstable.
technologies.name: Planet Smelting

technologies.desc: There may come a time when intellects, vast and cool and unsympathetic, regard our worlds with envy and draw plans against us. We must be ready.
technologies.name: Planetary Defenses

technologies.desc: Advances in material collection and processing allows our Arkships to engage in planetary-scale resource extraction efforts, or even reshape entire biomes as needed.
technologies.name: Planetary Engineering

technologies.desc: Once a colony has been firmly established and pioneers turn into citizens, the need for a strong local government providing stability trumps the colonial need for flexibility.
technologies.name: Unified Government

technologies.desc: Stronger alloys allow us to create prefabricated buildings, providing our colonies with the improved infrastructure.
technologies.name: Ceramo-Metal Infrastructure

technologies.desc: Advances in metallurgy permit us to build vastly larger and more durable structures, greatly improving the infrastructure of our colonies.
technologies.name: Durasteel Infrastructure

technologies.desc: Generating a strong energy shield within a planetary atmosphere is a greater challenge than in the vacuum of space, but it offers a potent defense against orbital bombardment.
technologies.name: Planetary Shields

technologies.desc: Ancient warring tribes, historical nations in conflict, now unified in empire. We must not, will not, crumble.
technologies.name: Societal Unification

technologies.desc: Weapons that eject destructive balls of high-energy plasma at targets. These plasma projectiles are extremely effective at eating through ship armor.
technologies.name: Plasma Throwers

technologies.desc: These new accelerators launch projectiles of high-energy plasma with improved containment fields. This results in less energy leakage as the projectile travels in space towards its target.
technologies.name: Plasma Accelerators

technologies.desc: The latest in plasma weaponry, these cannons are fully militarized versions of the older, somewhat improvised plasma throwers. Their plasma projectiles are even deadlier.
technologies.name: Plasma Cannons

technologies.desc: Expanding possibilities through the application of limited cybernetics.
technologies.name: Positronic Implants

technologies.desc: Load-balancing facilities can greatly improve the stability of local grids and feed excess power back into centralized capacitors.
technologies.name: Global Energy Management

technologies.desc: A re-engineered and unified grid further reduces energy losses over distance.
technologies.name: Planetary Power Grid

technologies.desc: Capacitors capable of storing vast amounts of energy is one of the cornerstones for any modern civilization.
technologies.name: High-Energy Capacitors

technologies.desc: Modulated fields allow for increased production and improved energy yield.
technologies.name: Field Modulation

technologies.desc: Basic entanglement principles applied to energy generation provide a substantial increase in energy output.
technologies.name: Quantum Energy States

technologies.desc: Quantum superposition of energy coils, simultaneously drained and charged.
technologies.name: Quantum Field Manipulation

technologies.desc: Wearing a powered exoskeleton suit augments the user's strength and speed. The military applications are obvious, but it will also increase labor efficiency.
technologies.name: Powered Exoskeletons

technologies.desc: Advances in the field of Psionics suggest the possibility of creating combat computers capable of reading and analyzing the impulses of telepathic operatives before they are cognitively processed.
technologies.name: Precognition Interface

technologies.desc: Just like how clever pre-FTLs move to conceal each other as they approach an enemy, so too can our pilots move faster without disrupting their cloaking field.
technologies.name: Predatory Tactics

technologies.desc: Are the precognitive powers of Numa at work or is it a matter of skilled craftsmanship? Either way this galactic stock market prediction model will forecast fluctuations in the economy with divine accuracy.
technologies.name: Numistic Data Modeling

technologies.desc: The Psi Jump Drive harnesses the psi energies emitted by the crew to force the vessel through the very fabric of reality, instantly "jumping" vast distances.
technologies.name: Psi Jump Drive

technologies.desc: Psionic emanations from the Shroud bring an entity's favor into corporeal reality. An empire attuned to a Shroud patron will emit a Psionic Aura from where their psionic populations are concentrated.
technologies.name: Psionic Aura

technologies.desc: These barriers are generated out of pure psionic energy by a cadre of psionic specialists. They will be able to stop some incoming fire, like our energy deflector systems, but without the prohibitive power consumption.
technologies.name: Psionic Barrier

technologies.desc: These small and nimble craft specialize in delivering concentrated payloads of psionic energy. The larger the target, the greater resonance its explosions achieve.
technologies.name: Psionic Bombers

technologies.desc: These highly-advanced disruptors fire a powerful lance of psionic energy through enemy hulls, allowing for the targeted disabling of hostile weaponry.
technologies.name: Psionic Disruptors

technologies.desc: By establishing a temporary psionic connection between one ship and another, a direct charge of mental power can be discharged to devastating effect. Such raw energy is capable of confusing ship systems and influencing the minds of the crew within.
technologies.name: Psionic Lightning

technologies.desc: These extremely powerful shields are generated out of pure psionic energy by a cadre of psionic specialists. Their powers are further augmented by large arrays of psi emitters.
technologies.name: Psionic Shields

technologies.desc: Devices that attenuate psionic energy are as difficult to construct as they are to understand. Such is the complexity of dealing with extradimensional forces.
technologies.name: Psionic Suppression

technologies.desc: The mind is in many ways a reflection of the universe itself, a microcosmos. Not all beings will reach this level of insight, but their minds are tools greater than any other.
technologies.name: Psionic Theory

technologies.desc: By harnessing the extreme thermal energy found on molten worlds, our starbases can increase the energy output in a system with exceptional efficiency.
technologies.name: Pyroclastic Resonation

technologies.desc: A Quantum Catapult harnesses the power of a Neutron Star or Pulsar to twist the fabric of space, skipping a fleet across great distances.
technologies.name: Quantum Catapult

technologies.desc: The process of soil deposition normally takes millions of years. With advanced fracking, chemical engineering, and hydraulic management technologies even the poorest substrate can be turned into fertile topsoil.
technologies.name: Soil Remediation

technologies.desc: The crystallization process is complicated and difficult, but synthetic crystals can be manufactured by using specialized industrial plants.
technologies.name: Rare Crystal Manufacturing

technologies.desc: Additional power generation systems increase the ship's reactor output.
technologies.name: Reactor Boosters

technologies.desc: The discovery of fusion power allows for better reactor boosters to be fitted onto our ships.
technologies.name: Improved Reactor Boosters

technologies.desc: The discovery of antimatter power allows for highly advanced reactor boosters that can greatly enhance ship reactors.
technologies.name: Advanced Reactor Boosters

technologies.desc: Standardizing workflows for upgrading and retrofitting ship components can lead to massive efficiency gains.
technologies.name: Refit Standards

technologies.desc: A genetically altered version of silicon-based bacteria could potentially be manipulated to regenerate non-organic materials.
technologies.name: Regenerative Hull Tissue

technologies.desc: Improving the support staff available to our commanders will increase the number of ships they can lead in a single fleet.
technologies.name: Admiralty Support Staff

technologies.desc: Compressing suitable materials into ultra-dense forms is a cheap and efficient way to improve their ability to absorb weapons-grade impacts.
technologies.name: Matter Compression

technologies.desc: Iterating on the standard conditioning regimen for ground troops has proven to make them more effective in direct combat.
technologies.name: Aggressive Conditioning

technologies.desc: Careful tuning of pain receptors allow soldiers to fight through what would previously have been debilitating injuries.
technologies.name: Nerve Dampeners

technologies.desc: Restructuring the managerial web linking core worlds to the capital can help alleviate the administrative stressors and information chokepoints that frequently arise within a budding empire.
technologies.name: Administrative Efficiency

technologies.desc: Regimens of periodic cell revitalization treatments keep the leader class spry and active beyond traditionally expected lifespans.
technologies.name: Cell Revitalization

technologies.desc: Cross-linking weapon systems to fire in staggered volleys improves the actual damage output of Military Stations over time.
technologies.name: Synchronized Firing Patterns

technologies.desc: Additional layers of armor plating within the structure itself improves the resilience of Military Stations.
technologies.name: Fortified Core Layers

technologies.desc: The basic mechanics of ship shields are complex, but they can be adjusted and improved in a multitude of ways.
technologies.name: Shield Harmonics

technologies.desc: The immense logistical support networks needed to maintain an upgraded Starbase can be further improved, allowing us to support more of these stations.
technologies.name: Interstellar Expansion

technologies.desc: Minor improvements to transmission efficiency adds up to a sizeable reduction in overall energy loss.
technologies.name: Applied Superconductivity

technologies.desc: Transgenic crops offer the nutritional elements of several standard food crops in one convenient package.
technologies.name: Transgenic Crops

technologies.desc: Changes in how mineral deposits are evaluated relative to each other lead to more efficient boring patterns.
technologies.name: Extraction Patterns

technologies.desc: Intensive study within the fields of nanomachinery and subspace phenomena will eventually yield a new L-Gate Insight into the Disabled L-Gate mystery.
technologies.name: L-Gate Insight

technologies.desc: Improved fleet management procedures will free up the resources needed to maintain a bigger fleet.
technologies.name: Fleet Management Procedures

technologies.desc: Increasingly powerful computation paradigms allow us to adapt individual construction projects to planetary and ultra-local gravitational conditions.
technologies.name: Gravitational Analysis

technologies.desc: The application of game and puzzle theory has the potential to greatly optimize modular assembly and construction.
technologies.name: Assembly Algorithms

technologies.desc: Perfecting the firing cadence of laser weaponry is a task that could keep the engineering elite of any given planet busy for centuries.
technologies.name: Focusing Arrays

technologies.desc: New developments in tech cooling regularly surface, improving the stability and efficiency of our weapons systems, keeping them from blowing up the ships upon which they are mounted.
technologies.name: Flash Coolant

technologies.desc: With the chemical reaction tightly controlled by missile-board microprocessors, warhead detonations can be tuned for maximum effect for local conditions at the time of impact.
technologies.name: Thermodynamic Yield Control

technologies.desc: Advances in miniaturization allow for more rapid loading and discharging of rocket-propelled payloads.
technologies.name: Miniaturized Pre-Igniters

technologies.desc: Ultra-dense slugs can punch through even the strongest of projected shields.
technologies.name: High-Density Munitions

technologies.desc: Minor technical advances combine with improved shipboard routines for handling munitions to provide a noticeable boost in fire rate.
technologies.name: Loader Efficiency

technologies.desc: Increasing the speed at which fighter pilots can process and act upon enemy positioning data elevates strike craft a few steps up the food chain.
technologies.name: Synapse Interceptors

technologies.desc: By collecting and analyzing the performance data of the pilots that came before, we have exponentially improved our pilot training methods. Each one will be quicker than the one that came before.
technologies.name: Iterative Pilot Training

technologies.desc: With careful study devoted to landscaping and the science of fun, the construction of entire worlds dedicated to leisure can be made possible.
technologies.name: Resort Worlds

technologies.desc: Efficiency in all things.
technologies.name: Resource Processing Algorithms

technologies.desc: It seems that space and time tend to gather together in layers, all laid on top of one another. The trick is how to slip between the folds.
technologies.name: Rift Sphere

technologies.desc: A Ring Segment allows for multiple planet-like zones, cannibalizing all other planets in the system for materials.
technologies.name: Ring Segment

technologies.desc: Rewritable assembly templates allow for the creation of bespoke robot designs.
technologies.name: Machine Template System

technologies.desc: Standardization of assembly templates allows for improved specialization of the machine population.
technologies.name: Machine Template System

technologies.desc: Improved production practices allow for greater alterations to robots without compromising core functionality.
technologies.name: Cross-Model Standardization

technologies.desc: Improved production practices allow for fundamental changes to robots without compromising core functionality.
technologies.name: Fungible Circuitry

technologies.desc: Advanced templates allow us to drastically increase the assembly of new robots.
technologies.name: Robotic Assembly Systems

technologies.desc: These artificial work units are perfect for menial labor tasks. They are hard-working and capable of following simple vocal instructions, but should not be expected to climb stairs.
technologies.name: Artificial Workforce

technologies.desc: Evolving artificial intellects are opening the door to the possibility for true synthetic sapience.
technologies.name: Positronic AI

technologies.desc: Nothing is quite as powerful as a well-placed insult, and we now know how to insult a species's progenitor in many languages.
technologies.name: Satisfying Insults

technologies.desc: Scientific Arkships combine the mobility of nomadic life with the full resources of a dedicated research institution, turning every system we visit into a new opportunity for discovery.
technologies.name: Scientific Arkships

technologies.desc: The research labs and databanks of a Science Nexus generate an immense flow of raw, undiluted science.
technologies.name: Science Nexus

technologies.desc: By analyzing the biological weaponry employed by the Swarm we can create self-propelled projectiles weapons spreading the very same horrific destruction.
technologies.name: Scourge Missiles

technologies.desc: The Baol Organism had a unique way of producing tools. Given the species' relative slowness, they would simply grow them out of organic matter in locations that were half orchard, half factory. With the proper genetic adjustments, we could also grow various commodities and tools alongside our regular crops.
technologies.name: Baol Organic Plant

technologies.desc: To build their ring world, the Cybrex relied on highly efficient mining drones to survey and harvest orbital resources. Cybrex-made memory chips and sensors could augment our own mining operations, so that we might put their millennia old algorithms to good use.
technologies.name: Cybrex Mining Hub

technologies.desc: The Irassian astronaval tradition was unmatched in their time. Their shipyards produced a constant stream of ships for their navy and merchant fleets, which would ultimately be their downfall. With so many ships, and such a high reliance on them, the Irassians were powerless to quarantine the disease that would claim their empire.
technologies.name: Irassian Naval Yards

technologies.desc: The sprawling empire of the First League dwarfed our own at its peak, and relied on implacable bureaucracy to keep the wheels of the state in motion. The quantic filing arrays they used afforded them unprecedented efficiency in the sorting and storing of documents.
technologies.name: First League Filing Offices

technologies.desc: The reality computers of the Vultaums were unique processing units, dedicated to analyzing existence itself, not quite through physics, but rather by trying to reverse engineer reality's source code and find the glitch that would finally allow the Vultaums to take down the simulation where they believed they lived.
technologies.name: Vultaum Reality Computer

technologies.desc: The Yuht were a paradoxical society, obsessed with the idea of finding other sentient species, yet refusing to accept that they were not alone. They were so focused on disproving any claim of alien life, that their bias found a way into their technology. However, with the proper modifications and calibrations, we could certainly fix their powerful detection arrays.
technologies.name: Yuht Astronomical Interferometer

technologies.desc: Zro is a fascinating element, prone to chaotic bursts of energy. We believe that with the right artifacts, we could use it to fuel spatial storms over entire solar systems.
technologies.name: Zroni Storm Caster

technologies.desc: Careful reproductive planning should be incentivized, lest we waste valuable genetic legacies.
technologies.name: Selected Lineages

technologies.desc: Modelled on organic DNA, these microscopic machine intellects are capable of autonomously assembling most components needed for new drones.
technologies.name: Self-Assembling Components

technologies.desc: Introspective prioritization.
technologies.name: Self-Evolving Logic

technologies.desc: These sensors have been tuned to look for any gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.
technologies.name: Gravitic Sensors

technologies.desc: Sensors that detect the subspace fluctuations left in the wake of traveling starships. Their sensitivity and range is greater than that of a gravitic sensor array.
technologies.name: Subspace Sensors

technologies.desc: Advanced sensors that rely on rotating tachyon beams to detect ship movements even at extreme distances.
technologies.name: Tachyon Sensors

technologies.desc: The diverse sensory organs of spaceborne life can be enhanced by our developed technologies with minimal harm to the organism.
technologies.name: Sensor Bio-integration

technologies.desc: The stages of the Sentry Array gradually expand sensor range, eventually covering the entire galaxy.
technologies.name: Sentry Array

technologies.desc: With these modifications, the fields generated by our shield emitters will partially deflect attacks that would otherwise bypass the shields.
technologies.name: Shield Hardening

technologies.desc: Zro particles raised to a high energy state add fluctuations to our shields that can deflect certain weapons that would otherwise easily penetrate the fields.
technologies.name: Advanced Shield Hardening

technologies.desc: These capacitors store surplus energy which can quickly be transferred to reinforce a ship's shields.
technologies.name: Shield Capacitors

technologies.desc: Energy deflector screens can stop a limited amount of incoming enemy fire before overloading. Their main drawback is that they consume large amounts of power.
technologies.name: Deflectors

technologies.desc: These updated deflector screens are capable of soaking up even more punishment before they overload.
technologies.name: Improved Deflectors

technologies.desc: These new shield generators represent the next generation of energy screens, replacing the older deflector technology. They offer significantly better protection.
technologies.name: Shields

technologies.desc: An updated shield generator that produces an even stronger energy field. Only sustained enemy fire can penetrate this barrier.
technologies.name: Advanced Shields

technologies.desc: These reinforced and hardened energy shields are incredibly powerful. The protection they offer is second to none.
technologies.name: Hyper Shields

technologies.desc: Reinforced nanocomposite hull plating can provide an extra layer of protection that could be the difference between life and death in a combat situation.
technologies.name: Nanocomposite Materials

technologies.desc: A combination of different metals and ceramics that result in a strong armor without sacrificing flexibility.
technologies.name: Ceramo-Metal Materials

technologies.desc: Plasteel is an elastic material that combines many of the qualities of plastics and metal. It is relatively cheap to produce and can be used to augment ship armor.
technologies.name: Plasteel Materials

technologies.desc: This strong yet flexible material is capable of withstanding severe punishment. It serves well as ship armor.
technologies.name: Durasteel Materials

technologies.desc: This incredibly dense and strong material can resist firepower that would turn armor made of any other alloys into slag.
technologies.name: Neutronium Materials

technologies.desc: These dampening field generators offer much needed protection to ships traversing cosmic storms.
technologies.name: Storm Dampening Generators

technologies.desc: This special coating charges the ship's exterior with a storm dampening field, leading to more efficient protection against storms.
technologies.name: Storm Breaker Coating

technologies.desc: A new approach to alloy use in military applications significantly reduces the ability of cosmic storms to interfere with energy weaponry and explosive payloads.
technologies.name: Payload Padding

technologies.desc: This novel approach to ship architecture will significantly reduce the negative effects cosmic storms have on our weapon systems.
technologies.name: Tempest Cage Architecture

technologies.desc: Through the creation of special slave-breeding worlds, we can ensure that we will always have a steady supply of disposable laborers.
technologies.name: Thrall-Worlds

technologies.desc: The study of alien life has moved beyond mere cataloging. By examining the structures and survival strategies of organisms evolved under foreign stars, we open new avenues in medicine, adaptation, and design.
technologies.name: Xenobiology

technologies.desc: Through recursive axonal scaffolding and synaptic reticulation, we have developed methods for reorganizing the electrochemical topology of conscious matter. Neurons do not merely transmit - they entwine, organize, and remember. Now, they do so according to our design.
technologies.name: Neural Weaving

technologies.desc: Life, in all its staggering variety, is composed of repeating patterns and modular structures. By decoding and replicating these at every scale, we now wield a holistic blueprint of biology. There is little left in nature we do not understand, and less still we cannot recreate.
technologies.name: Biostructural Synthesis

technologies.desc: Advances in solar panel technology could offset the operating costs of our starbases. The panels would require an entire starbase module to generate enough energy, however.
technologies.name: Orbital Energy Conversion

technologies.desc: Void Clouds use the electrical charges generated by the dense gases that make up most of their core to release bolts of burning plasma. Using the same gas composition together with a specialized conduit allows for powerful lightning weaponry.
technologies.name: Cloud Lightning Conduits

technologies.desc: Construction in space presents our engineers with new design challenges that must be solved before we can build orbital stations above other worlds.
technologies.name: Offworld Construction

technologies.desc: This will enable the construction of defensive deep space platforms to protect our Starbases.
technologies.name: Deep Space Defenses

technologies.desc: The creation of a dedicated naval engineering corps will greatly benefit the construction of deep space defense platforms, decreasing building costs and increasing durability.
technologies.name: Corps of Engineers

technologies.desc: The realization of faster-than-light travel is a new dawn for space exploration. Manned missions to other star systems are now not only possible, but necessary.
technologies.name: Space Exploration

technologies.desc: The addition of internal refineries on mining stations will substantially increase mineral production.
technologies.name: Zero-G Refineries

technologies.desc: Increased scanner range will allow us to more quickly identify mineral concentrations, and focus our mining efforts there.
technologies.name: Long-Range Mineral Scanners

technologies.desc: These powerful short-range lasers can easily slice through rock, making the extraction of minerals a more efficient affair.
technologies.name: Mineral Cutting Beams

technologies.desc: Fleets of autonomous drones equipped with mining beams are deployed to quickly and efficiently gather nearby minerals.
technologies.name: Autonomous Mining Drones

technologies.desc: These special probes are equipped with swarms of nanites that identify previously unknown mineral concentrations and mark them for later extraction.
technologies.name: Nanite Mineral Probes

technologies.desc: A lot of critical research can only be done in a zero gravity environment, which these specialized laboratories are eminently designed for.
technologies.name: Zero-G Laboratories

technologies.desc: Containment force fields are excellent for isolating and holding various substances or specimens so they can be analyzed in detail.
technologies.name: Miniature Containment Fields

technologies.desc: Advanced probes that can thoroughly analyze subjects on a sub-atomic level, generating a wealth of valuable research data.
technologies.name: Quantum Probes

technologies.desc: Increased automation of station functions will free up more staff for research duties.
technologies.name: Autonomous Station Protocols

technologies.desc: Studying something from the limited perspective of a single dimensional reality does not paint the whole picture. Every angle must be considered.
technologies.name: Multi-Dimensional Analysis

technologies.desc: Trade across interstellar distances presents a new set of challenges to overcome. It is critical to achieve the transfer of goods from one system to another in a timely and above all cost efficient manner.
technologies.name: Offworld Trade Companies

technologies.desc: Adapting the Tiyanki method of siphoning energy from gaseous matter, it is possible to construct weapons draining energy from enemy ships.
technologies.name: Frequency Tuning

technologies.desc: A centralized space installation built in close orbit around the system primary is necessary to make full use of the resources in a star system.
technologies.name: Starbase Construction

technologies.desc: The earliest starbases were little more than makeshift outposts. Permanent starports will enable us to maintain a firmer grip on star systems.
technologies.name: Starport

technologies.desc: As space traffic increases, larger and more defensible starbases are needed to maintain control over system spacelanes.
technologies.name: Starhold

technologies.desc: These mighty space forts will provide a focal point for all military activity in a star system, and their presence is sure to deter all but the most stubborn attackers.
technologies.name: Star Fortress

technologies.desc: Plans for an immense battlestation capable of holding its own against several strike fleets are now being drawn up. If realized, these citadels will become monuments to greatness as much as system hubs.
technologies.name: Citadel

technologies.desc: Like any potential hazard, the dangerous radiation from our star's transformation can also be harnessed as a useful tool. Channeling it as a beam weapon would allow us to overheat and disable enemy ships. Unlocks a Colony Decision to construct a Starfire Cannon in orbit.
technologies.name: Starfire Cannon

technologies.desc: These facilities grow sleek, agile biological ships designed for precision and speed. Employing advanced biopods and specialized nutrient solutions, they produce vessels capable of precise and efficient strikes.
technologies.name: Standardized Stinger Incubation

technologies.desc: Refined facilities accelerate growth cycles and improve bio-engineered precision, resulting in vessels with superior maneuverability and accuracy. These enhancements make the Stinger a devastating force in tactical engagements.
technologies.name: Improved Stinger Development

technologies.desc: The apex of bioship growth technology, these advanced facilities produce Stingers of unmatched speed and lethality. Optimized genetic templates and cutting-edge incubation techniques ensure these ships dominate any battlefield with swift and deadly precision.
technologies.name: Advanced Stinger Development

technologies.desc: Stingers are designed to deliver devastating strikes against high-value targets. They excel in exploiting weaknesses in enemy defenses.
technologies.name: Stingers

technologies.desc: By harnessing the principles behind storm negation technologies, we can begin to manipulate the astrometeorological nature of the galaxy to serve our own needs.
technologies.name: Storm Manipulation

technologies.desc: Through the use of scientific weather models, we can track the movement and formation of impending Cosmic Storms.
technologies.name: Cosmic Weather Models

technologies.desc: By applying probability currents to our scientific weather models, our ability to track the movement and formation of impending Cosmic Storms is greatly increased.
technologies.name: Probability Current

technologies.desc: A facility synchronizing the national Starbase network, augmenting defensive and offensive capabilities.
technologies.name: Strategic Coordination Center

technologies.desc: These manned strike craft are launched from a mothership and rely on their speed and small size to survive long enough to punch through enemy defenses.
technologies.name: Carrier Operations

technologies.desc: The next generation of strike craft, featuring improved avionics, better handling characteristics and more powerful armaments.
technologies.name: Improved Strike Craft

technologies.desc: A further refinement in strike craft design, these advanced strike craft are a pilot's dream. Their performance far exceeds that of previous models.
technologies.name: Advanced Strike Craft

technologies.desc: Learning from the design expertise of Skrand and his people, these superior strike craft are capable of prolonged engagement and highly adaptive tactics.
technologies.name: Skravird Strike Craft

technologies.desc: Deep-tissue implants are the latest innovation in the revolutionary overlapping of sensory engineering and entertainment experiences. "Where we're going, we won't need skin to feel!"
technologies.name: Subdermal Stimulation

technologies.desc: An insight borne of a desperate desire to leave our home, these Subspace Drive engines were designed to facilitate limited interstellar travel. While only allowing small-scale jumps, they provide a unique opportunity to jumpstart our galactic exploration.
technologies.name: Subspace Drive

technologies.desc: What we thought was the greatest alloy turned out to be far from the truth. Countless pre-FTL refining processes have been cataloged, and we have now synthesized an unbeatable metal.
technologies.name: Supreme Alloy

technologies.desc: Collecting specimens from defeated Prethoryn enables us to clone and genetically program a war-brood of our own.
technologies.name: Swarm Spawning Pools

technologies.desc: These smaller missiles are launched in volleys and have been specifically designed to overwhelm enemy point-defense systems.
technologies.name: Swarmer Missiles

technologies.desc: New miniaturization techniques will allow us to equip swarmer missiles with more powerful warheads and improved flight performance.
technologies.name: Whirlwind Missiles

technologies.desc: Aligning defensive and offensive weapon execution paradigms allows for increased efficiency.
technologies.name: Synchronized Defenses

technologies.desc: This compendium, a gift from Cetana, is a tapestry of profound insights, elegantly composed and dense with meaning. It offers more than knowledge; it challenges and reshapes our understanding of technology, society, and the fabric of consciousness itself.
technologies.name: Cetana's Thought

technologies.desc: Equipped with a personality, synthetics will finally be able to interact socially on equal terms with the rest of our citizens. Some units may even assume leadership roles.
technologies.name: Artificial Personality Matrix

technologies.desc: Thinking outside the box merely places you in another, somewhat larger box.
technologies.name: Synthetic Thought Patterns

technologies.desc: Highly advanced units that are stronger, faster and more durable than the vast majority of organics. With their upgraded neural processors they are fully capable of independent operations.
technologies.name: Artificial Administration

technologies.desc: Once fully adapted to the basics of Psionics, the mind is capable of connecting to other individuals, becoming something greater.
technologies.name: Telepathy

technologies.desc: Transportation networks bring people together: a sentiment shared by many civilization we observed. While we do not have steam engines, our hyper relay networks could serve a similar purpose.
technologies.name: Temple of Transportation

technologies.desc: There is no simple solution to the problem of macro-scale reshaping of planetary crusts - only bigger trowels and orbitally-deployed drills.
technologies.name: Terrestrial Sculpting

technologies.desc: Telepaths can monitor the citizenry for incorrect thoughts, but with some study they could also correct thought aberrations that they find.
technologies.name: Thought Enforcement

technologies.desc: Simple yet moderately effective chemical thrusters that rely on combustible propellant to function.
technologies.name: Chemical Thrusters

technologies.desc: These electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.
technologies.name: Ion Thrusters

technologies.desc: An advanced form of electric propulsion, plasma thrusters afford ships greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.
technologies.name: Plasma Thrusters

technologies.desc: These highly advanced fusion-powered thrusters provide ships with unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.
technologies.name: Impulse Thrusters

technologies.desc: Artificial thrusters can be integrated into spaceborne organisms with appropriate considerations for energy supply and connections to neural motor centers.
technologies.name: Thruster Bio-integration

technologies.desc: Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable titans.
technologies.name: Improved Titan Hulls

technologies.desc: The latest generation of titan hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.
technologies.name: Advanced Titan Hulls

technologies.desc: Designing ships at this scale allows for a deadly combination of exceptional firepower and cutting-edge auxiliary support. Titan configurations may serve as highly versatile flagships which are also capable of bolstering surrounding vessels or ensnaring hostiles.
technologies.name: Titans

technologies.desc: Through comprehensive study of irradiated environments we will allow our settlers to colonize worlds that have been devastated by nuclear warfare.
technologies.name: Tomb World Adaptation

technologies.desc: These torpedoes are essentially very large, slow-moving missiles. They are equipped with more powerful warheads and shield modulators that let them slip unmolested through energy screens.
technologies.name: Space Torpedoes

technologies.desc: Upgraded space torpedoes encased in armor, to better withstand enemy point-defense fire. The armor fragments into shards that cause additional damage when the torpedo detonates.
technologies.name: Armored Torpedoes

technologies.desc: Advanced torpedoes with very powerful warheads. They have a sleeker design, faster engines and upgraded shield modulators for slipping through energy screens.
technologies.name: Devastator Torpedoes

technologies.desc: Given enough processing power, networked sensors and distributed stations, even the ocean currents can be managed to a fine level of control.
technologies.name: Ocean Ecology Management

technologies.desc: Further advancements in the field of subdermal implants can provide detailed information regarding the movements and actions of the implanted.
technologies.name: Tracking Implants

technologies.desc: Leaving our planetary cradle has opened us up to a new understanding of faith, and its place in a wider context.
technologies.name: Metacognitive Faith

technologies.desc: Different societies have developed alternative solutions for their logistics and computing. These alien ways of thinking have made it easier for us to adapt to foreign empires' structures.
technologies.name: Trinary Computing

technologies.desc: Redundant thought centers allow for a Crystalline Entity to split itself in two as a final gambit to protect its clutch against a particularly dangerous foe.
technologies.name: Fissile Cores

technologies.desc: The powerful digestive system of a Cutholoid can be repurposed to fire kinetic projectiles at extremely high velocity.
technologies.name: Gastric Fountain

technologies.desc: On death, the Tiyanki Matriarch produces an assortment of protective chemicals in a final attempt to preserve the lives of her remaining kin.
technologies.name: Restorative Enzymes

technologies.desc: Modified Flagella spawn that siphon nutrients and materials from their prey in order to support the regeneration of their host Amoeba.
technologies.name: Leechcraft

technologies.desc: A main source of energy for large creatures in deep space comes from the power of starlight. The closer they are to brighter stars, the faster they develop.
technologies.name: Starborne Biology

technologies.desc: The somber song of the Tiyanki inspires its fellow creatures, hardening their resolve in combat.
technologies.name: Herdsong Chords

technologies.desc: Cysts filled with reproductive fluid allow for each Voidworm in a fertile Troika to independently produce spawn when bombarding an inhabited planet.
technologies.name: Virulent Cysts

technologies.desc: The purpose of one is the purpose of all. Together, we are greater than the sum of our parts.
technologies.name: Unity of Purpose

technologies.desc: These powerful immunology boosters make disease a thing of the past, allowing organic populations to live fuller, healthier lives. May cause serious side effects.
technologies.name: Universal Macrophage

technologies.desc: Nothing is more innovative than natural evolution. By studying how pre-FTL societies view their world, we have devised new methods of detecting uninvited ships.
technologies.name: Unusual Senses

technologies.desc: Where the body fails, science intervenes.
technologies.name: Vitality Boosters

technologies.desc: We can develop a cure for Voidworm parasitic infection. All of our colonies would be rendered immune to their current strain of spore bombardment.
technologies.name: Voidworm Immunity

technologies.desc: Aside from the obvious safety concerns, the artificial creation of Volatile Motes is an extremely delicate and complicated process that requires highly specialized equipment.
technologies.name: Volatile Material Plants

technologies.desc: When deployed, this facility slowly transforms a planet into a volcanic paradise, surfacing useful resources along the way. Thermoforgers can accelerate the transformation.
technologies.name: Volcanic Forge

technologies.desc: Advances in material technology and deep-shaft mining techniques allow geo-engineering at previously unthinkable depths and temperatures. We can terraform a Volcanic World into a temperate planet.
technologies.name: Volcanic Terraforming

technologies.desc: Advances in material technology and deep-shaft mining techniques allow geo-engineering at previously unthinkable depths and temperatures. Magma hotspots can now be exploited, suppressed, or even relocated.
technologies.name: Deep Crust Engineering

technologies.desc: Waystations collect celestial resources and form interstellar trade routes.
technologies.name: Waystations

technologies.desc: Our Waystations are no longer simple markers along the stars. Improved logistics allow them to store greater reserves and transfer resources more efficiently along established Waylines.
technologies.name: Improved Wayline Logistics

technologies.desc: Advanced coordination protocols bind distant Waystations into a cohesive network. Resources, signals, and supplies move across the Waylines with unmatched precision.
technologies.name: Advanced Wayline Logistics

technologies.desc: Biologically enhanced projectiles are fired, countering evasive maneuvers and striking agile targets.
technologies.name: Vector Lock Cannon

technologies.desc: Fires refined projectiles with superior tracking enzymes and adaptive flight paths, increasing hit rates against fast-moving targets.
technologies.name: Enzymatic Webcaster

technologies.desc: Deploys self-guided bio-munitions that lock onto movement patterns, ensuring accuracy against elusive enemies.
technologies.name: Seeker Shard Array

technologies.desc: Utilizes complex organic targeting systems that anticipate evasive actions, making even the most agile prey vulnerable.
technologies.name: Pinion Accelerator

technologies.desc: Fires intelligent bio-projectiles equipped with predictive tracking, overcoming the most sophisticated evasion protocols.
technologies.name: Prey Tracker

technologies.desc: Deploys bio-plasma rounds that adapt mid-flight, guaranteeing hits against even the most erratic maneuvers.
technologies.name: Precision Lancer

technologies.desc: Launches organic projectiles that release specialized enzymes, interfering with enemy weapon reloading systems and reducing their rate of fire.
technologies.name: Reload Jammer

technologies.desc: Enhances disruption enzymes to interfere more effectively with reloading cycles, significantly delaying enemy volleys.
technologies.name: Fire Disrupter

technologies.desc: Deploys intelligent bio-projectiles that target critical reloading systems, creating cascading delays across enemy fleets.
technologies.name: Mind Missiles

technologies.desc: Utilizes adaptive biological compounds that degrade reloading mechanisms, halving the firing efficiency of even the most advanced weaponry.
technologies.name: Degradation Beams

technologies.desc: Fires advanced munitions that emit suppression fields, crippling enemy reloading systems and rendering them painfully slow.
technologies.name: Fiend Disabler

technologies.desc: Releases a biological pulse that locks down enemy reloading for extended periods.
technologies.name: Tracker Stopper

technologies.desc: Organic projectiles imbued with destabilizing enzymes scramble enemy targeting systems and reduce their accuracy.
technologies.name: Gloom Spores

technologies.desc: Refined biological compounds disrupt targeting systems and short-range communications, sowing chaos among enemy ranks.
technologies.name: Tangle Pulse

technologies.desc: Adaptive bio-munitions are deployed to exploit neural weaknesses in both organic and synthetic crews, crippling enemy efficiency.
technologies.name: Neuro Scourge

technologies.desc: Intelligent bio-projectiles emit disruptive fields on impact, scrambling enemy targeting systems and causing widespread malfunctions.
technologies.name: Ruin Barbs

technologies.desc: Advanced biological ordnance creates a cascading feedback loop within enemy systems, rendering their attacks wildly ineffective.
technologies.name: Snare Darts

technologies.desc: Bio-electromagnetic pulses incapacitate targeting systems and leave fleets in a state of disarray.
technologies.name: Havoc Storm

technologies.desc: Fires bio-projectiles that emit bursts of energy upon impact, subtly enhancing the maneuverability of our vessels.
technologies.name: Energy Burster

technologies.desc: Releases concentrated bio-energetic fields, further boosting the evasion capabilities of our ships.
technologies.name: Tangler Pod Launcher

technologies.desc: Launches intelligent bio-projectiles that adaptively enhance agility, ensuring superior evasion even in the most chaotic battles.
technologies.name: Agile Spike Array

technologies.desc: Deploys advanced munitions that generate dynamic bio-electric auras, significantly improving the ability of ships to evade enemy fire.
technologies.name: Electro Sprayer

technologies.desc: Fires highly advanced projectiles that create large-scale enhancement fields, granting unparalleled evasion to fleets.
technologies.name: Evasion Darts

technologies.desc: Fires bio-munitions that emit fields of adaptive energy, allowing fleets to dance effortlessly out of harm's way.
technologies.name: Adaptive Tendrils

technologies.desc: Fires organic projectiles that emit energizing biofields, subtly increasing the firing speed of weapons systems.
technologies.name: Weaver Biofield Generators

technologies.desc: Refined bio-munitions enhance biofield intensity, further accelerating the rate of fire.
technologies.name: Weaver Booster Blaster

technologies.desc: Deploys adaptive bio-projectiles that amplify reaction times and system efficiency, enabling a significant increase in fire rate.
technologies.name: Weaver Organo-Tech Amplifier

technologies.desc: Generates dynamic bio-electric auras, vastly enhancing firing speed across multiple vessels, ensuring relentless pressure on enemy fleets.
technologies.name: Weaver Aura Caster

technologies.desc: Unleashes hyper-charged bio-munitions that create large-scale enhancement fields, enabling fleets to unleash sustained, rapid-fire barrages.
technologies.name: Weaver Swift Shooter

technologies.desc: Projects waves of bio-energy that push our weaponry to their peak performance, flooding the battlefield with devastating firepower.
technologies.name: Weaver Wave Maker

technologies.desc: Regenerative pods are launched to deliver strong healing compounds to allied ships.
technologies.name: Spore Launcher

technologies.desc: Highly efficient pods imbued with healing biomatter are deployed to rapidly repair damage across multiple vessels.
technologies.name: Improved Spore Launcher

technologies.desc: Pods containing repair agents are launched, optimizing healing based on the severity of damage and ensuring no vulnerabilities remain.
technologies.name: Advanced Spore Launcher

technologies.desc: Pods that saturate the battlefield with adaptive spores provide smart healing to all allied vessels within range.
technologies.name: Adaptive Spore Launcher

technologies.desc: Deploys pods that unleash a wave of intelligent microorganisms, capable of revitalizing even the most damaged fleets.
technologies.name: Intelligent Adaptive Spore Launcher

technologies.desc: Pods filled with malleable cells are launched to trigger the growth of new hull tissues, pushing the endurance of organic vessels beyond their former limits.
technologies.name: Rebirth Spores

technologies.desc: These facilities nurture mid-sized biological ships within refined biopods, employing enhanced nutrient delivery and genetic optimization to produce agile and adaptable vessels for the fleet.
technologies.name: Standardized Weaver Incubation

technologies.desc: These facilities employ enhanced bio-engineering techniques to accelerate growth cycles and enhance vessel adaptability. Improved genetic matrices and optimized environments ensure these biological ships are both durable and highly responsive in combat.
technologies.name: Improved Weaver Development

technologies.desc: These facilities produce biological ships of unparalleled precision and versatility. Revolutionary growth techniques and adaptive genetic enhancements result in vessels that thrive in even the most demanding tactical scenarios.
technologies.name: Advanced Weaver Development

technologies.desc: Building on the foundations of early bio-engineering, Weavers are crafted to balance agility with increased combat capabilities.
technologies.name: Weavers

technologies.desc: We can accelerate the fluency of global, collective thought by investing it in gatherings of symbionts whose sole purpose in life is to facilitate that same will.
technologies.name: Clustered Synapses

technologies.desc: Our mutualistic will shall be strengthened by vast gatherings of deeply empathic symbionts, so in-tune with their surroundings as to concentrate and re-broadcast our collective thought.
technologies.name: Confluence of Thought

technologies.desc: By encouraging the growth of deep-thinking symbionts in glades throughout our distributed self, our collective will shall be felt more keenly by all.
technologies.name: Centers of Being

technologies.desc: To spread our roots to a new world first requires us to prepare the seedbed. By first terraforming a planet we can ensure that our colonies are off to a healthy start.
technologies.name: Planetary Germination

technologies.desc: A naturally occurring subspace wormhole is a fickle thing, and its fluctuating energy levels typically make it impossible to travel safely between its linked apertures. There are ways to temporarily stabilize its matrix, however.
technologies.name: Wormhole Stabilization

technologies.desc: After analyzing a multitude of artists from drastically different cultures, we have come up with a general theorem. By studying a civilization's art and culture, we can gain an advantage against them in combat.
technologies.name: Xeno-Aesthetics

technologies.desc: Advancing our understanding of interactions with - and manipulations of - the xeno is a necessary step in forming more permanent interstellar alliances.
technologies.name: Xeno Diplomacy

technologies.desc: Given recent encounters with intelligent races, it is essential that we improve our xeno-linguistic capabilities.
technologies.name: Xeno-Linguistics

technologies.desc: The complexities of interstellar diplomacy necessitate the forming of bonds with foreign powers in order to further one's goals.
technologies.name: Xeno Relations

technologies.desc: This corporate agency promotes a wide variety of interstellar tourist attractions, as well as offering employment packages and signing bonuses to potential emigrants interested in relocating to corporate space.
technologies.name: Xeno Outreach Agencies

technologies.desc: These generators extract vacuum energy, providing an almost limitless supply of ship power. There is no more efficient way to generate energy.
technologies.name: Zero Point Power

technologies.desc: These highly concentrated pellets of zro can be dispersed through enemy shields unabated, shifting through multiple realities. Once contact is made with a physical object, the effects are exponential in devastation.
technologies.name: Zro Launchers
